I won't be able to look him in the eye knowing I didn't do absolutely everything to keep every seat. Peter, I am appealing to you now, _not as a Senator,_ but as a conservative who has nowhere left to turn. **This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?

Friend, I want to address a deeply concerning development affecting families across our state: **the suspension of maternity services at Southern Tennessee Regional Health System in Pulaski.** With the hospital’s only obstetric provider having left and no sustainable coverage for labor and delivery, expectant mothers in Pulaski must now travel long distances for basic maternal care. No family should face that reality in Tennessee. Unfortunately, this is not an isolated case. **More than half of rural hospitals in Tennessee no longer offer obstetric services** , and our state has been among the hardest hit by rural hospital closures nationwide. These closures force pregnant women to drive an hour or more for care—often during medical emergencies—placing mothers and babies at serious risk. The consequences are devastating. Tennessee has one of the **highest maternal mortality rates in the country** , with approximately **41 maternal deaths per 100,000 live births** , far exceeding the national average. Fetal and infant mortality rates are also unacceptably high, particularly in rural communities and among families with fewer resources. These outcomes are not inevitable—they are the result of policy choices. We can do better, and we must. I support practical, proven solutions, including:
* **Funding and expanding midwife and doula training programs** , especially for providers who commit to serving rural and underserved areas.
* **Deploying mobile maternal care units** —maternal health buses that provide prenatal care, screenings, and postpartum follow-up directly to rural communities, similar to successful programs already operating in Alabama.
* **Targeted investment in rural health infrastructure** to stabilize hospitals and clinics and ensure they can recruit and retain maternal health providers.

Supporting mothers and babies is not just a health issue—it is an investment in Tennessee’s future. When families are healthy and supported, our communities are stronger, our workforce is stronger, and our state is stronger. **As your candidate for governor, I am committed to fighting for solutions that put families first—not leaving rural communities behind.** [**Can you support our campaign with a $5 donation today to help us fight for every mother and every baby to have access to the healthcare they deserve?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126581587/605345733/-843357993?refcode=3.3.26_ maternal_health&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2M2NWUyMS01ZDE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fHkUPbnJhuXXVEUbeCAlnowgjrtIV4GrncNQwERrXoc=) | | [DONATE $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126581589/605345735/-843357993?refcode=3.3.26_ maternal_health&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2M2NWUyMS01ZDE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fHkUPbnJhuXXVEUbeCAlnowgjrtIV4GrncNQwERrXoc=)

# [#] Team,

Thank you.

I wanted to take a moment to reach out personally and express my gratitude for your continued support of our campaign.

With gratitude,

Josh Gottheimer

Marlene Galán-Woods is a former broadcast journalist and mother of five who has lived in Arizona for the past 36 years. Her parents fled communist Cuba looking for a better life. disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
#
**_Katie Porter spoke at the California Democratic Party Convention last week, please take a moment to read her remarks below and[then split a donation between State Democrats Committee and Katie’s campaign for governor.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/101155?refcode=em20260303-10131&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10131%2E614464%2Ed9m2w4)_**
I’m Katie Porter. Some of you know me as the whiteboard lady who held CEOs and billionaires accountable in Congress.
So today, I wanna start with one simple, powerful message we all agree on.
Say it with me. Ready, 1 ... 2 ... 3...
**_Fuck Trump._**
Yeah, that’s right, Fuck Trump. Together, we’re going to kick Trump’s ass in November and stop him in his tracks.
I’ll stand up to Trump and his cronies again and again, just as I did in Congress—with or without my whiteboard. But this election for Governor is about far more than defeating Trump.
We **_KNOW_** what Trump is willing to do and how far he’s willing to go – he’s willing to kill people in the streets, to rip health care away, to ruthlessly attack our democracy.
But this governor’s race asks US — what are WE willing to do? What is CALIFORNIA willing to do for our democracy?
Who we elect as our next Governor is the biggest, most powerful statement we can make in 2026 about who Democrats are, in California, and nationally. About what we stand for, and about what we will do.
Let’s elect a bold leader who WILL DO big things – the things we have long fought for. When I’m your governor, I will deliver:
* Single payer health care,
* Less expensive housing,
* Free child care for all,
* Zero tuition charges at our UCs and CSUs,
* And, thousands of dollars back in families pockets, by eliminating California income tax for those earning less than $100,000.

Those are real affordability solutions!
For decades, we have fought for these ideas. We’ve organized. We’ve voted. We’ve pushed this party to be better.
I am running for Governor because I am WILLING and READY to get those things done!
But you know who is standing in our way? Billionaires and huge corporations that have far too much power in our country—and too much influence in Sacramento. I’ll take them DOWN and LIFT UP the working people of this state.
Look I understand, there’s a lot that makes me unique in this race—and some of that scares people. I’m the single mom of three kids, I push a grocery cart, fill my minivan with gas, and pay the bills. I understand what it’s like to watch expenses like utilities and insurance go up and dollars not stretch far enough, because I’ve experienced that too.
We’ve never had a governor like that in California. Heck, we’ve never had a governor in heels! And I think it’s about damn time.
My differences will make me a better Governor, better able to address the challenges Californians face.
California Democrats, our country is counting on us to lead the way—to send a message about our democracy—by rejecting billionaires and corporate-backed candidates—and picking as governor, the ONLY candidate who has NEVER taken a dime of corporate PAC money.
In this election, there is a very real possibility that Republicans could sneak two candidates into the runoff. We CANNOT let that happen.
But let’s aim higher than stopping them. Let’s seize the opportunity to elect someone who is WILLING to get big things done and READY to live up to our progressive ideals.
My campaign IS our Democratic values, powered by small donations from 70,000 people just like you. And how you campaign is how you serve. I humbly ask for your support, not to be Governor “Of” California, but to Govern FOR ALL Californians.
Thank you.
_And Fuck Trump._
Katie Porter is running for governor to stand up to Trump and lower costs for working families. We need your help to win. **[Please split $15 between Katie and State Democrats Committee today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/101155?refcode=em20260303-10131&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=15&t=2&akid=10131%2E614464%2Ed9m2w4)**

name: Hong for Wisconsin
subject: The other candidates won't say it
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
Six Americans dead. 165 students and teachers buried.
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260303-2573)
Peter,
Six American service members have died in the strikes on Iran. When asked about the deaths, Trump said: ”'We expect casualties, but in the end it's going to be a great deal for the world.”
Right now, more than 400 Wisconsin National Guard soldiers are stationed in Kuwait and Iraq, in harm’s way. We must bring them home safely.
On Saturday — the day the strikes began — I was the only candidate in this race to speak up about the killing of 165 Iranian elementary school students and their teachers. As I write this, that's still the case. Since then, the UN Secretary-General and UNESCO have condemned the strike as a grave violation of international law. The other candidates still haven't said a word.
I understand why they're silent — it's politically safe. But I'm not running for governor to be safe. I'm running because Wisconsin deserves a leader who tells the truth — about the cost of war, about who pays the price, and about the moral bankruptcy of a government that will spend billions on bombs while telling working families there's no money left for them.
We can oppose a dictator AND oppose an illegal war. We can grieve for schoolgirls buried under rubble AND hope for the safety of American service members. We can want freedom for the Iranian people AND demand our government follow the Constitution.
As governor, my job will be to fight for Wisconsinites — to lower costs, protect democracy, and make sure working people can build a good life here.
But leadership is also about values. I will always choose human life over political convenience.
**[If you think that's the kind of leadership Wisconsin needs, stand with me today.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260303.97iMBL&refcode=em20260303-2573&t=1&akid=2573%2E105371%2EGKqnHD)**

With gratitude,
— Fran

clean_body: I won’t let Trump lie about Portland.| | | = | | For months now, President Trump has been attacking Portland — misrepresenting our city, demonizing our neighbors, and using fear to score political points. Trump has relied on this distorted coverage to claim Portland is “like living in hell,” to threaten sending in the National Guard, and to label Oregonians “paid terrorists” and “paid agitators.” But that is not the Portland I know. Portland is beautiful, vibrant, and resilient. It’s where families build their futures and communities come together. Like every major city, we face real challenges — but spreading lies about our city only makes them harder to solve. Portland is a city worth supporting — not demonizing. name: Mai Vang
subject: We’re at war.
body:
Approved $3.3 billion in new weapons aid to Israel. But now they act shocked that we’re in another illegal, immoral, and unnecessary war.

| | | | | | [|
---](https://maiforus.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe5f60ccb8fb671f0c1857dc9&id=970963c7d8&e=dd5af5b7b1)
| | | | | | Friends,

The United States and Israel are now in a full-fledged war against Iran. At least six US servicemembers have been killed. Hundreds of Iranian schoolgirls were massacred in Tehran. Gas prices are set to skyrocket. And it’s just the beginning.

Here’s what’s most infuriating:

**The political establishment -- including my opponent, Doris Matsui -- recently approved $3.3 billion in new weapons aid to Israel. But now they act shocked that we’re in another illegal, immoral, and unnecessary war.**

The war machine must be stopped.

[**If you believe it’s time for a new generation of leaders willing to say no to endless wars, and no to blank checks for Israel, add your name now.**](https://maiforus.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe5f60ccb8fb671f0c1857dc9&id=c72bdcd1f0&e=dd5af5b7b1)

body:
The lawsuit the Supreme Court agreed to hear isn't about fairness. It's not about so-called "election integrity," because millions of taxpayers' dollars have been wasted on state investigations looking for mail-in ballot fraud that simply does not exist.
This lawsuit is a political ploy to suppress legitimate mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day and potentially delayed by the U.S. Postal Service. This lawsuit targets our fellow citizens who have done nothing wrong and might have their vote suppressed through delays out of their control. And it's all because the political party that brought the lawsuit knows that those delayed ballots are more likely to have been cast by voters for the other party and not themselves.
We cannot let anyone get away with such a cynical attempt at hidden voter suppression, no matter who controls the Supreme Court. RUSH $35 or more right now to help us spread the word about this lawsuit and defend the right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030326_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SCOTUS to Hear GOP Lawsuit That Could Radically Restrict Mail Voting [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030326_3&amount=25]
Team: Mail-in ballots are under attack again.
The Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments in RNC v. Wetzel, a lawsuit challenging Mississippi’s law allowing a five-day grace period for late-arriving ballots mailed by Election Day. In simpler terms, it's a case about whether your vote will count if you mail it on or before Election Day, but your ballot arrives after Election Day.
It's clear why a political party -- in this case, the Republican National Committee (RNC) -- is claiming that states must reject ballots that arrive after Election Day. Doing so would potentially disenfranchise a large number of voters, restricting the number of participants in an election. And the data is clear, over the last several election cycles, Republicans have been outnumbered in the use of mail-in ballots.
The RNC is making a blunt decision that their ability to win elections matters more than your vote. It's a cynical attempt to stay in power by suppressing ballots that are delivered late by the postal service. It's the kind of partisan work that shows they'd rather believe in their own power and control than the principles of democracy, of a country where all our votes should count, regardless of party.

Our position is clear: If your ballot was postmarked by Election Day, it should count.
This shouldn't be a partisan question. No political party -- Democrat, Republican, Green, Working Families, Libertarian, Reform, Conservative -- should be against voting. No party in our democracy should want to restrict the fundamental right of our fellow citizens to make their voice heard through voting.
But now we're facing a case where the Supreme Court’s decision could strike down or uphold laws in 16 states (and Washington D.C.) allowing late-arriving ballots postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted if they arrive within a set grace period.
How do we know what is at stake? Data from the 2024 Massachusetts elections shows that their three-day grace period for ballots to arrive after Election Day resulted in a 60% drop in rejected ballots as compared to no grace period. That means thousands of votes still counted, more than 1.5% of the total vote count. In a close election, that 1.5% could easily mean the difference between winning and losing.

### Texas Is About to Shake. And Latino Voters Are Holding the Fault Line
Chuck Rocha flew into Sacramento. Mike Madrid held court with the California Senate Democratic Caucus. And then they sat down to record one of the most data-packed episodes we've done in a while.
This week's episode drops the day before the Texas primary -- and the numbers we're seeing are genuinely hard to explain. In Tarrant County alone, Democratic early vote went from 9,000 in 2018 to over 51,000 this cycle. Thirty-point swings. Republicans switching ballots. First-time primary voters showing up out of nowhere. Something is happening in Texas, and the pollsters aren't capturing it.
Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.

The Crockett vs. Talarico Senate race is the one to watch. Not because of the candidates themselves -- but because Latino voters are going to decide it. Chuck breaks down exactly why, with the kind of back-of-the-napkin math only he can pull off. Mike explains what it will mean for the broader narrative about how Latinos vote -- and whether the Democratic Party has actually learned anything from 2024.
We also get into the Republican civil war between Cornyn and Paxton (over $100 million spent, making it the most expensive Senate primary in U.S. history), why Bobby Polito might be the most important candidate nobody's talking about, and the one warning sign Democrats should not ignore heading into November: a $450 million Republican war chest that dwarfs anything on the left.
Plus -- we're announcing the first-ever Latino Vote Summit in Washington, D.C. this summer. More details coming soon, but if you want to be in the room, hit reply and let us know.

clean_body: These emails are the best way for our campaign to stay in touch with supporters like you. If you'd prefer, you can . = Hey, it’s Harry Dunn. I want to share some personal news with you. I’ve officially launched my campaign for Congress to represent Maryland’s 5th District. = | | = As a Capitol Police Officer and as an American, January 6th, 2021, was the darkest day of my life. I was immersed for what felt like countless hours in a profane mix of sweat, screams, shrieks, anger, death, fear, blood, broken limbs, spit, hatred, horror, racism, and bigotry. The wounds that my heroic fellow officers endured are still healing. But my commitment to ensuring the strength of our democracy has only deepened. It’s the reason I’ve decided to run for Congress for Maryland’s 5th District. I made this choice because I cannot sit idly by while our very right to survive is under attack by Donald Trump. I’ve fought against his angry mob before, and I’m ready to do it again. So I’m asking you to make a choice, Peter: \-- Either we sit back, let the bigots win, and allow dark money to buy this seat out from under us. \-- Or we can step up and prove we won’t surrender in the face of hate. = | = | = | = | = | = | = Together, Harry Dunn | These emails are the best way for our campaign to stay in touch with supporters like you. The U.S. Supreme Court just blocked a New York state court decision that ordered a new congressional map after ruling that the current map illegally discriminates against Black and brown voters. Allowing an unfair map to be used this November isn’t just bad for voters in New York — it has a significant impact on the redistricting crisis that’s playing out across the country.
When Republicans started manipulating the maps in states like Texas, Missouri, and North Carolina, they didn’t hide the fact that it was a ploy to cling to power in the midterms. And this ruling, as Reuters reports, provides a “potential boost to Republican hopes of retaining control of Congress in November's elections.”
**This is why Democrats can’t just sit back and hope for the best.** Republicans are trying to stack the deck to make it impossible for them to lose power. It’s why the NDRC strongly supports states like California and Virginia taking temporary steps to counter these schemes.
This redistricting emergency just got worse. name: Marie Gluesenkamp Perez
subject: Affordability isn’t just a buzzword
body:
| | Peter,

Everywhere I go across the district, I hear similar concerns: grocery prices are up, utility bills are up, health insurance premiums are climbing, and childcare is so expensive that many parents feel like they’re working just to pay the daycare bill.

Families and everyday people here and nationwide are doing everything they can to make ends meet, but the deck isn’t stacked in their favor. It feels like the basics are slipping further and further out of reach.

[I’m tackling the affordability crisis head-on and deliver solutions wherever possible, but to keep this work going, I need to hear directly from you about what’s hitting your household the hardest. Will you take a minute to fill out our quick survey? →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126584139/605393805/1182309762?refcode=MGP_EM_SV_90DO_260303_1_1&refcode2=aab9d093-6a17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYWI5ZDA5My02YTE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mqn7P_wW07DDK0QzRV3hoVepLKMgqMKAVKxcGyeFRCg=&emci=0165b78c-6a17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=aab9d093-6a17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=31138575)

Peter, I deeply understand the struggles working families in Southwest Washington face because I’ve faced them myself.

My husband and I went without health insurance for a long time, and I used to carry my toddler around on my hip while working in our auto shop, because health coverage and childcare were simply out of our budget.

That’s why I introduced legislation to expand access to quality childcare in rural areas, and protect affordable healthcare. I’m also addressing affordability with my “Right to Repair” work, ensuring ordinary people can fix their own stuff – whether it’s a car or household appliance – and make it last instead of being forced to buy cheap, disposable replacements.

[I’m tackling this crisis from every angle, and I’m not backing down – and your input is crucial to guiding the work still ahead. By sharing your most urgent concerns, you help me target where this fight matters most and build a more affordable future for all.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126584141/605393807/1182309762?refcode=MGP_EM_SV_90DO_260303_1_1&refcode2=aab9d093-6a17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYWI5ZDA5My02YTE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mqn7P_wW07DDK0QzRV3hoVepLKMgqMKAVKxcGyeFRCg=&emci=0165b78c-6a17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=aab9d093-6a17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=31138575)

body:
I’m officially the Democratic nominee for North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat, and I’m running against Republican Michael Whatley, a far-right lobbyist and President Trump’s handpicked candidate.
| | | | | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6509?t=6&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)
---
Peter, it’s official!

Just minutes ago, I won the Democratic nomination for North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat. I’ll be running against Republican Michael Whatley, a far-right Big Oil lobbyist and President Trump’s handpicked candidate.
As I start my general election campaign, I’m thinking about how grateful I am for the support of folks like you that got me here. **This is the time to stand up and fight for our future – and I am ready. But I need you with me.**
**[My team and I have set a goal to raise $1 million before Thursday at midnight to kick off the general election campaign. Will you chip in $5 today to help us win the biggest Senate race in the country, break the GOP’s hold on Washington and return power to the people?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6509?t=7&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6510?t=8&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6511?t=9&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6656?t=10&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)
---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6509?t=11&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)
---
I didn’t plan to run for federal office. I wanted to serve North Carolina from right here at home. But when I look at what’s happening across the country, I know I can’t leave things as they are for my daughters or for yours.
So long as Trump’s extreme allies are in power, there is no path to accountability or restraint. Just more chaos, division and attacks on our fundamental freedoms.
**To set our nation back on course, we must regain Senate control – and that starts by winning in North Carolina.** We can flip this seat from red to blue for the first time since 2008, but far-right Republican PACs and megadonors will spend hundreds of millions to stop us.
**[Whether they succeed depends on people like you, Peter, stepping up to help us hit our goal before Thursday night. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help us reach our primary day fundraising goal and build the momentum we need to win?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6509?t=12&akid=667%2E124072%2ELXZBvm)**
Thank you for everything.

Roy
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

clean_body: The House must pass the Iran War Powers Resolution (H.Con.Res 38) this week to affirm and preserve our Constitutional power. | Peter — At 2 AM on Saturday, the U.S. and Israel bombed targets across Iran, killing an estimated 555 Iranians. Among the dead were 150 people, including children, at a Southern Tehran girls’ school. Iran has launched retaliatory strikes, killing six American soldiers — so far. President Trump says there will be more American casualties because “That often happens in war.” The American people don’t want this war. Congress hasn’t authorized this war. Trump promised to be a president who got us out of wars, not into them. I represent 73,000 veterans, as well as the servicemembers and military families stationed at Naval Base Kitsap. Putting American lives at risk should be a last resort, not a way to distract from low poll numbers or embarrassing Epstein revelations. The House must pass the Iran War Powers Resolution (H.Con.Res 38) this week to affirm and preserve our Constitutional power. I’ll never stop fighting for you. – Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. body:
Marjorie Taylor Greene shocked the nation when she announced her resignation from Congress.
| Marjorie Taylor Greene shocked the nation when she announced her resignation from Congress.

That resignation has triggered a special election in GA‐14, now set for March 10, 2026.

**This district — our district — is suddenly on the brink of deciding more than just one seat._It could determine who controls Congress._**

I’m Shawn Harris. I’m a Democrat. Husband. Father. Retired Brigadier General. Farmer. **And I’m running to represent Northwest Georgia with the seriousness, steadiness, and leadership it’s been missing for years.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/104252?t=6&akid=23184%2E878179%2EPnv875) Make no mistake — **MTG’s resignation is not the end of the chaos she created._Not yet._**

If Republicans hold this seat, they’ll likely elect someone who carries on her legacy: Another extremist. Another conspiracy theorist. Another chaos candidate. Another vote for dangerous, divisive MAGA politics. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/104252?t=7&akid=23184%2E878179%2EPnv875) But we — together — have the opportunity to change that.**If we win GA‐14, we don’t just change one district. We send a signal to Congress that the era of chaos is over.**

That’s why I’m writing today: I need you with me, and I need you now.

[We are mobilizing a field program, building a digital operation, and organizing voter outreach — but this special election moves fast, and we need resources immediately. If you can, split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project. subject: An Epstein Class War.
body:
This isn’t just a "foreign policy blunder"—it is a calculated Epstein-class-war.

| | | | | [|

## An Epstein Class War
---
| |
Friend,
While the "Epstein-class" elites watch their defense stocks soar from the safety of their private jets, families across this country will have to pay the price for a war in Iran that we never asked for.
**This isn’t just a "foreign policy blunder"—it is a calculated Epstein-class-war. It is a conflict designed by and for a detached ruling class that treats our soldiers as expendable pawns and our planet as a resource to be plundered.**
[**We have to fight back. We need representatives who REJECT war. Can you send us a few dollars to ensure our campaign can make it to the airwaves with our message?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=7c12a22a8c&e=8c53948e4c)
The ramifications for us at home will be nothing short of disastrous.
* While billions are funneled into munitions and overseas strikes, our own communities will continue to face crumbling infrastructure and a healthcare system that preys on the sick.

* Every bomb dropped is a multimillion dollar seed investment of violence, anger, and retribution, planted for future generations to deal with.

* War is the ultimate polluter, accelerating environmental destruction while diverting the resources we need to build a sustainable future.

We are at a breaking point. The working class are tired of being told to wait their turn while the ultra-rich profit from global chaos. We need leaders who aren’t bought-off or sycophants to an ineffective and feckless Party apparatus—someone who will put People, Peace, and Planet first.
[**Rose is standing up to the rot in this system, but she can't do it without your support. To take on the "Epstein-class," we need a movement powered by you. Can you help us fight back with a donation today?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=4b47c74250&e=8c53948e4c)
It’s time to end the era of wars fought for the benefit of the Epstein class. Let’s build a future that belongs to all of us. You in?
---
| |

In solidarity,Rose Penelope YeeCandidate, US Congress CA-02

| | I hold the same Senate seat that Wayne Morse did decades ago. Senator Morse's legacy runs long for Oregonians as a voice for peace, oversight, and accountability. **He was one of only 2 Senators to vote against the original authorization for America's escalation in Vietnam.** In 2002, America seemingly forgot the lessons that Vietnam taught us. I voted _against_ the Iraq war — and I so wish my vote had prevailed. That was a time when we sorely needed more leaders with the foresight that people like Senator Morse once had. The mistake of ignoring the not-so-distant past led to a country destroyed, thousands of Americans dead, trillions of wasted dollars (just before the Great Recession, no less), and a region destabilized. **Which brings us to today, when I fear we're about to make the same mistake**** _again_****.** Donald Trump — instead of addressing economic instability, reining in the surveillance state, or giving the country transparency on the Epstein files — has chosen to drag America further down the path of destruction by launching unauthorized and reckless strikes against Iran. These strikes have already left 6 American servicemembers and hundreds of civilians dead. Regional partners are being drawn into the conflict. Oil prices are spiking. And the administration keeps offering conflicting answers as to the mission and endgame. **Oregonians don't want another senseless and costly war in the Middle East, and I will do everything in my power to prevent one.** This week, I will vote for a War Powers Resolution to constrain Trump's actions on Iran. Trump may "admire" dictators like Vladimir Putin, but the Constitution specifies he can't act like Putin and unilaterally start a war on a personal whim. **The separation and balance of powers still exist in America, much as Trump may pretend otherwise.** In 2002, I rejected the idea that sacrificing American lives in the Middle East for "regime change" would make our country safer. My stance is no different in 2026. I urge folks everywhere to make their voices heard and demand a swift resolution to this crisis. More soon, _Ron_ |

Oregonians don't want another senseless and costly war in the Middle East, and I will do everything in my power to prevent one. This week, I will vote for a War Powers Resolution to constrain Trump's actions on Iran. Trump may "admire" dictators like Vladimir Putin, but the Constitution specifies he can't act like Putin and unilaterally start a war on a personal whim. The separation and balance of powers still exist in America, much as Trump may pretend otherwise. In 2002, I rejected the idea that sacrificing American lives in the Middle East for "regime change" would make our country safer. My stance is no different in 2026. I urge folks everywhere to make their voices heard and demand a swift resolution to this crisis. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: It’s official: I will be facing Greg Abbott this November
body:
Tonight’s win couldn’t have been possible without you, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**It’s official, Peter! AP just called the race in the Texas Democratic Primary election, and I’ll be facing Greg Abbott this November.**
And now, we move into the next phase of this race with one mission in mind — defeating Greg Abbott and ending the era of corruption and negligence he has inflicted on Texas.
Thank you, Peter. This wouldn’t have been possible without your support.
To every volunteer who knocked doors, every organizer who made the calls, every supporter who chipped in what they could, and every Texan who believed in this campaign early, thank you. You carried us over the first big hurdle and made it clear that Texans are ready to turn the page.
Now the general election is underway, and our mission is clear. We are going to defeat Greg Abbott and end the era of corruption and negligence he has inflicted on Texas.
**[If you’re ready to keep the pressure on and keep building momentum, will you pitch in $5 right now to help us start strong?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260303_3_results.SW2F02&refcode=em20260303-695&amount=5&t=1&akid=695%2E299639%2EHx5d_F)**
Politics was never the plan for me. But when they tried to close my son’s neighborhood school, I couldn’t just stand on the sidelines and do nothing about it — so I turned my anger into action and ran for the school board to change things. _And I won._ Since then, I’ve fought for Texas families alongside union teachers and parents of every political background because this is not about party. It is about putting our kids first.
**As the Democratic nominee for Governor, I will fight for Texans the same way I fight for my own kids,_with everything I’ve got._**
As Governor of Texas, I will work to build a state where:
* You can see a doctor without worrying that it will bankrupt your family.
* Your paycheck goes further at the grocery store and at the pharmacy
* And make sure every child has a strong neighborhood public school, with supported teachers and safe classrooms.

After over a decade of Greg Abbott, Texans have watched the cost of living explode, public schools gutted and politicized, corruption run rampant, and millions denied health care. Texans are ready for something better.
But Abbott has a massive $106 million war chest, and starting today, his billionaire donors are ready to write a blank check just to keep him in power.
**[That is why I’m asking. Will you help power my campaign with a contribution of $5 today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260303_3_results.SW2F02&refcode=em20260303-695&amount=5&t=2&akid=695%2E299639%2EHx5d_F)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260303_3_results.SW2F02&amount=5&refcode=em20260303-695&t=21&akid=695%2E299639%2EHx5d_F)
Let’s win this together.
With gratitude,
Gina Hinojosa

[ Donate » ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_footer?refcode=em20260303-3&t=22&refcode2=695_299639_Hx5d_F&akid=695%2E299639%2EHx5d_F)

## Is this finally the End of the War on Terror?
---
Peter Ohtaki — March 2, 2026
---
_**Imagine a peaceful, modern Iran integrated into the world’s economy**_ \- an Iran that not only doesn’t make a nuclear bomb, but also ends support of terrorist proxies Hezbollah, Hamas and Houthis, stops making ballistic missiles, and ends Sharia Law.**Remember** “Death to America, Death to Israel” was not just a slogan of the Iranian regime, it was a foreign policy choice and its excuse for economic failure made by Ayotollah Khameni and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard for 47 years.I remember watching ABC’s _Nightline_ during the 444 days of captivity of U.S. embassy hostages in 1980, followed by Hezbollah’s bombing that killed 240 marines in 1983, and the Iranian-supplied IEDs (Improvised Explosive Devices) that killed 1,790 American troops in Iraq, Hamas’ Oct. 7, 2023 attack on Israel, and at least 7,000 Iranian protestors recently killed by the Islamic Republic. Read more on the Middle East in _[Are you Oppressed or an Oppressor](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69a7ad331faff42270e5ebd8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2019%2F4-27%2Fethnicstudiesgaza%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69a4f0711f2ad765017dce58%26ss_email_id%3D69a7ad331faff42270e5ebd8%26ss_campaign_name%3DIs%2Bthis%2Bthe%2BEnd%2Bof%2Bthe%2BWar%2Bon%2BTerror%253F%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-03-04T03%253A55%253A33Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_69a4f0711f2ad765017dce58&l=en-US&s=XO1znSKEEoWMeipLHEOD9X6I3DA%3D)?_.
---
|
---
| Islamic Republic of Iran flag vs pre-1979 Iranian flag
---
**Why Now?** Iran is militarily weak after Israel destroyed Iran’s air defense and enrichment facilities last summer, decapitated Hezbollah, and eliminated Hamas in Gaza after the Oct 7 attack. The Abraham accords between Israel and many Arab countries have diplomatically isolated Iran since 2016. Iran’s negotiating strategy for decades is to delay any agreement limiting it’s nuclear program. Even last week, Iran reportedly refused free uranium fuel for peaceful nuclear power, instead of giving up on enrichment.**End of the War on Terror** I know our track record on regime changes has not been good, but the U.S. attack on the Iranian regime today including the assassination of Ayotollah Khameni and 40 Revolutionary Guard leadership is morally justified.7,000 American solders died in the War on Terror fighting Al Qaeda and ISIS in Iraq and Afganistan. If the next regime in Iran ends support of Hezbollah, Hamas and Houthi, stops producing ballistic missiles, and renounces developing a nuclear bomb lifting sanctions, it would mark the **End of the War on Terror.****Lessons for our other Adversaries** _To China:_ American military superiority is no paper tiger. Complete air superiority combined with a strategy of decapitation in Iran should seriously deter Chinese Communist Party ambitions for Taiwan, especially after President Xi’s recent purge of People’s Liberation Army generals. China has been getting cheap oil from Iran and Venezuela for decades._To Russia:_ America will give Israel’s Iron Dome missile defense technology, and a NATO No-Fly Zone with peacekeepers to defend Ukraine. America will give Ukraine what it needs to destroy your plant manufacturing the Iranian-designed Shahed drones, roughly 600 miles east of Moscow. Iran fired 900 Shahed drones in the last 48-hours toward the Gulf states hitting the U.S. embassy in Riyadh.Read more in _[Cold War 2.0.](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69a7ad331faff42270e5ebd8&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2F2024%2F5-4%2Fcoldwar20%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69a4f0711f2ad765017dce58%26ss_email_id%3D69a7ad331faff42270e5ebd8%26ss_campaign_name%3DIs%2Bthis%2Bthe%2BEnd%2Bof%2Bthe%2BWar%2Bon%2BTerror%253F%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-03-04T03%253A55%253A33Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_69a4f0711f2ad765017dce58&l=en-US&s=1himmGjeN-emeKsmjkaSsJZEk40%3D)_

name: Trey Trainor for Congress
subject: Reflections on an Honor: Thank You, CD 21
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trey Trainor for Texas
body:
Grateful beyond words for your trust and dedication; together, we'll keep defending the conservative principles that make Texas strong...

| | | | | [|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=257f1bced8&e=4d3fe76c62)
| | Peter,
Tonight I want to express my sincere gratitude to the voters across Texas Congressional District 21 who placed their trust in me during this primary election. Although the outcome was not what we had hoped for, I am deeply thankful for every voter who supported our campaign and believed in our message.
I have spent my life fighting for the conservative values that make Texas strong. Faith, family, freedom, and the rule of law are principles that have guided my service and will continue to guide me moving forward.
Over the course of this campaign, I had the privilege of traveling across District 21 and meeting thousands of remarkable Texans who love this state and care deeply about the future of our country. The conversations we shared and the friendships formed along the way have been one of the greatest honors of this journey.
This campaign was powered by an incredible team of volunteers and supporters who gave their time, energy, prayers, and resources to help us reach voters across the district. Together we built a grassroots effort rooted in conviction, service, and a shared belief that the best days of Texas are still ahead.
To everyone who knocked on doors, made calls, prayed for our campaign, donated, or cast a vote in support of this effort, **thank you**. Your encouragement and support mean more than I can fully express.
While this election has concluded, the work of defending conservative principles and strengthening our country continues. I remain committed to standing for election integrity, constitutional government, and the values that Texans hold dear.
Thank you for your faith, your support, and your dedication to the future of Texas.
God bless you, and God bless Texas,
**Trey Trainor** Husband, Father of 6

subject: Students need education, not indoctrination
body:
If you haven’t heard of the Sunrise Movement, they are a youth climate activist group with ties to George Soros

| | |

Friend,

Did you know about Sunrise Movement’s involvement with the National Education Association (NEA) — the nation’s largest teachers’ union?

**If you haven’t heard of the Sunrise Movement, they are a youth climate activist group with ties to George Soros** that sponsors K-12 school clubs and has received funding from donor organizations such as the Ford Foundation, the Tides Foundation, and the Windward Fund.

Recently, Sunrise Movement hosted a Zoom event featuring the NEA president, who claimed the NEA would **_“leverage its 3 million members, and thousands of local affiliates to 'advocate,' 'mobilize,' 'litigate,' and 'elect people' aligned with its political goals.”_**

It's clear the NEA has a political agenda. Now, they are coordinating with other activist groups to force that political agenda on our children.

Defending Education is a national grassroots organization working to restore schools at all levels from activists imposing harmful agendas.

Through network and coalition building, investigative reporting, litigation, and engagement, we fight indoctrination in classrooms and on campus to promote the reestablishment of a quality, non-political education for all students.

**You can[join the fight to remove politics from education](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z44tvbu5j17v2vcgiftb38agaam5vij0aomg5i68_rp22sh2s8i6epr2cdh64p74cdh2bs) by donating to Defending Education today!**

We’ve shared Sunrise Movement's training guidebook that urges students to “take action” for a “political revolution.” This includes walkout guides, “day of action” strategies, and training on how to respond to federal agents on school property.

**At Defending Education, we believe that schools are meant to be safe places for learning, not recruiting grounds for political activism.**

Your generous support empowers us to expose the indoctrination, politicalization, and corruption going on in our education systems. Click below to donate.

Nicole Neily

But here’s the reality: _we cannot continue this fight without your support_.

## US Orders Navy Escort for Gulf Tankers
President Trump said the Navy will begin escorting tankers through the Strait of Hormuz "as soon as possible" if necessary and ordered the U.S. Development Finance Corporation to [provide political risk insurance](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAQRk8DHcgem58tXKSh27QpkcHDMonByJ7F2dtHRMoJ0nzNJ70nvY_7eLfkaX-82w0NL2HcMSePzBjHQJ7t_oUR0xwiJ8Zvm45I2wgC2kqoSujRWfKvUZfOLIiAqkQjuw5aAK36cjXL1PfTBK7TEubm1irXLUr0asLbpOA2l2QumlBCSyk62daqaRSicFLoRrq-K7RARxxi_Rlo5xUX_wonxnoOW-nNynykQr0VMBQw5JzreZ_m6yxguNAFDEL9zTNVFO1eZRsrTydWz8NZxlSvvPkyGndk8p5Se2kfmyX_q-F_tTkN_AQAAP__Vz12sw) for all maritime trade through the Gulf. Earlier Tuesday, [Trump wrote of Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M2K4zAQBOCnsW4JUus3Bx0WFt-yp4U9miZqx9qRLSN1ksnbD55XmGsVfAX17zpdMZe83f_gSpHnOm306oWYqU01F8btgxr1W23cmT6x7y2vE0hwJ6lP0kwJc3lPRqQ4EwFpQVF5Dw7A6CCWSIgeEQK5ADBflHI-WBkC-tkmCChyPDSppVFKeuXO2lpNJJOSxqoU_GAkpcy1nf_XvPFCc3nXJ7Xzra6ixIV574P-NcA4wMjtwUuvt4zl6I_QyEZYftcNS_rbHus-wLjXzn2AUSmnnIUA2nhtLgasaDHtr1xK7u6Yvq-YvynBP_rnGeErAAD__yXCd0E): _"Their air defense, Air Force, Navy, and Leadership is gone. They want to talk. I said 'Too Late!’"_ Meanwhile, Israeli missiles struck the [Assembly of Experts building](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLvO3CAQRp8Gd7OCAV9SUKRx96dNabFmWJNgsGD24rePHClPkGaakY7Od35-LV8uppgfP9xOlkNZMr1bImaqS4mJXf5NldpaKjemj2tHjfuCEgeQGqRZvIvpXEznbSBC0h1ZNY44IBo9dZsNUk0mTNMgexydIa_MN5RD8KtavZShi_aiSS2NUnJUw033vSaSXknTKz-NwkjykUu9_Sox80YhneVF9baWvUt2Yz6a0N8FzgLnfB6l8fUSOF9ggbPU_8671OThmihwjq06SnAv-71BrC434HLA_kzJbQ1cA97ohLU8M8OrMDUIpUKmD0N7HpV2gkTOU4VKxxVI4NxV6493TCm24TJ_7C6mv6b8X3lfFv8EAAD___DRj9c) in Qom while Iranian clerics were reportedly counting votes to replace Supreme Leader Khamenei in an effort aimed at preventing the regime from reconstituting its leadership. The Assembly [selected Mojtaba Khamenei](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu2zAMRb9G3hRIlGwng4Yu3tK1o8FYdKyGtgyJTeq_L1zgfcFbCJAEDs69v-7jHROn7fkTVwoy53GjT2USoTLmxILbiwrVKRepQn-x7iWtIxjotHHa-DFi4mP0TQwzEZBrKNi-hw7Au2uzhAiIYD2CczdjunZ2EN2jf7hb3_pHtE0KJ8044601ve0urm0dkYnW-NbGa6-8oZgkl8vvnDZZaOYjv6lcprw2HBaRvSr3Q8GgYNiOPVc5XwqGE6xgMO5rfHLhqM-ICgY8UDIzLvq14EobpaozR6qia940MU1CUUvW9c9eaCXNhJHKeSm0M06kl1R1xHjuuYiCoSkh7p_EnGp3mj9XTPzfVL5V7zvAvwAAAP__kgyPRA), 56, the late supreme leader's son, as his replacement, according to opposition outlet _Iran International_. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. I'm writing this on the plane, in true author fashion, on the way back cross country. It was wonderful seeing so many familiar faces and meeting new people on the book tour. Thank you to Rikki Schlott, Nancy Scola, Rainn Wilson, Kristen Sze, and Jon Sposato for agreeing to moderate convos. The LA event got postponed because I got caught in the blizzard. But I made it to SF and Seattle, which were very welcoming.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d5b8103-aa73-4a40-88c4-19c7803ded0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What were the takeaways of the "Hey Yang, Where's My Thousand Bucks?" tour?
For one, I was generally surprised by the number of completely new faces. I kind of expected it to be a reunion tour, but it wasn't. At each event, there were a few people who would say, "I finally get to meet you!" These were people who supported me back in 2020, but had never gotten a chance to say hello. One of them was abroad for several years, for example. So that was nice.
Some people came by who had already read the [book](https://substack.com/redirect/b5600f82-ede7-4402-a38a-8ead7bb1965d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and enjoyed it. That felt good.
I got a lot of questions about AI. It's on everyone's mind, rightfully so. I debated the topic, "Will AI make work obsolete?" for Open to Debate in Washington D.C. last week while on tour. I took the affirmative side. The recording will be out this weekend. I thought my side won.
As if on cue, Block on Thursday announced that they were laying off 4,000 of their 10,000 workers, the highest percentage of layoffs in the history of the Fortune 500. Jack Dorsey explicitly attributed it to AI and building smarter. Their stock jumped 20% immediately. Expect other companies to follow suit in the days ahead. The Fuckening is on and picking up steam.
Attendees were out on the two-party system and eager for an alternative. I made a stop in Richmond for a speaking event about the American political system that drew several thousand people. No one thinks the status quo is working. One person said, "I didn't know what to expect. But you've made me hopeful again."
The mood out there is generally not awesome and looking for something.

body:
This is how authoritarians talk
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126596262/605410186/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk4YjAxNGM3LWNiMTctZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTFmMGE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=hU90S7EU4mXxFjP1wafBPH6g4KM__quxhdxm-XLyqhM=&emci=136be6b2-5117-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=98b014c7-cb17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=8431045)
---

Peter, Kristi Noem just said the quiet part out loud: **“When it gets to Election Day, we’ve been proactive to make sure we have the right people voting, electing the right leaders to lead this country.”** The “right people”? Electing the “right leaders”? Since Trump’s second term began, Republicans have been trying to reshape the way elections work — they want politicians to pick their voters, and not the other way around. It’s why they’re trying to redraw maps all over the country. It's why they’re trying to make it so much harder for millions of eligible American citizens to vote, especially voters of color, married women who have changed their last names, people without a passport, and students. It's why they’ve dropped hints that masked federal agents could show up at polling places to intimidate voters — and reportedly are even considering declaring a state of emergency to allow the White House to assert executive power over elections. It's all about making sure “the right leaders” can cling to power. This is how authoritarians talk. And it’s a brazen attack on our democracy. **We can’t let them get away with any of it. clean_body: This is how authoritarians talk | Peter, Kristi Noem just said the quiet part out loud: “When it gets to Election Day, we’ve been proactive to make sure we have the right people voting, electing the right leaders to lead this country.” The “right people”? Electing the “right leaders”? Since Trump’s second term began, Republicans have been trying to reshape the way elections work — they want politicians to pick their voters, and not the other way around. It’s why they’re trying to redraw maps all over the country. It's why they’re trying to make it so much harder for millions of eligible American citizens to vote, especially voters of color, married women who have changed their last names, people without a passport, and students. It's why they’ve dropped hints that masked federal agents could show up at polling places to intimidate voters — and reportedly are even considering declaring a state of emergency to allow the White House to assert executive power over elections. It's all about making sure “the right leaders” can cling to power. This is how authoritarians talk. And it’s a brazen attack on our democracy. We can’t let them get away with any of it. That’s why the NDRC is doubling down on our work to protect fair maps and equal representation. **The fact that California is leading the way is telling.**
At the center of the fight is _**[Mirabelli](https://substack.com/redirect/bdeccc57-7a67-4b1d-b886-08cf44e1d110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[v.](https://substack.com/redirect/bdeccc57-7a67-4b1d-b886-08cf44e1d110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[Bonta](https://substack.com/redirect/bdeccc57-7a67-4b1d-b886-08cf44e1d110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_ , a lawsuit challenging California policies that prohibited teachers from informing parents if a child adopted a different gender identity at school.
Teachers and parents that challenged the CA policy argued that it forced educators to actively conceal information from families.
They argued that such active concealment violated constitutional principles that parents -- not government institutions -- have the primary authority to direct the upbringing of their children.
A federal district court agreed and ruled that schools cannot require teachers to keep such "secrets" from parents. This is is far more than a secret but decisions that can and have permanently altered the lives of so many youth and teenagers.
The case then moved to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, which temporarily paused the ruling while the appeal continues.
But the most important development came from the Supreme Court of the United States.
The Supreme Court's Message
The Supreme Court allowed the lower court's injunction PROTECTING parental rights to remain in place during the appeal process and said:
**" California's policies ... substantially interfere with the right of parents to guide the religious development of their children," says the court's majority opinion (unsigned) in **_**[Mirabelli](https://substack.com/redirect/bdeccc57-7a67-4b1d-b886-08cf44e1d110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[v.](https://substack.com/redirect/bdeccc57-7a67-4b1d-b886-08cf44e1d110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[Bonta](https://substack.com/redirect/bdeccc57-7a67-4b1d-b886-08cf44e1d110?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**.**
This is a clear signal that the justices are taking this Fundamental Constitutional Question seriously.
What does this message mean?
_**The Supreme Court is now willing to step in when government policies attempt to sideline parents from their fundamental rights as parents and just maybe - Parents Know Best .**_
Legal observers involved in this case and others that are making their way to SCOTUS, could soon become a landmark parental-rights decision clarifying that schools cannot deliberately keep parents in the dark about major issues affecting their children.
And that should matter deeply to families in Connecticut.
# Connecticut is Worse than California
_**Most Connecticut residents do not realize that similar policies already exist here.**_
Guidance from the Connecticut State Department of Education allows schools to socially transition students -- changing names and pronouns in school -- without notifying parents if the student asks the school to keep it CONFIDENTIAL.
What this Means? CT Schools may:
• Use one name and identity internally
• Use another identity when communicating with parents (with teachers upholding a charade)
• Withhold discussions about gender identity occurring at school
Parents - Our CT school officials get the last say in telling parents what they think they should know as to what is happening in their own child's life.
# **Are You Outraged? You Should Be**
**Connecticut 's Not So Quiet Erosion of Parental Rights**
The issue extends well beyond schools.
Connecticut healthcare laws already allows minors to receive certain healthcare services without parental knowledge or consent, including:
• Mental-health counseling
• Testing and treatment for sexually transmitted infections
• Certain reproductive health services
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1ff89b62-8e51-4eb1-9ea6-8422aafbfa29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Healthcare providers cannot disclose those services to parents without the minor's permission.
That means a teenager can receive treatment while parents may be legally blocked from accessing the medical information.
The modern teenager who cannot vote or buy cigarettes or alcohol can make life altering decisions with no parent information and consent.
What is next - every rebellious child is emancipated from a parent and becomes a child of then state? Not exactly, except in healthcare decisions.
# Why This Case Exists: Parents Fought Back
# The lawsuit in California exists because parents and teachers refused to accept these policies. They got motivated, got active and went to court.
They challenged the government.
And they forced the issue into the federal judiciary which extracts the issue from the oppressive state system.
Without those parents standing up, this constitutional question would likely never have reached the Supreme Court.
# Connecticut Parents Must Wake Up
In Connecticut, many of these policies were implemented quietly through administrative guidance and legislation passed under one-party control in Hartford.
Parents have not challenged them sufficiently.
That silence has allowed the erosion of parental rights to move much further here than many residents realize.
At least the Supreme Court of the United States is beginning to confront the issue directly and realizing a need to uphold the Constitution at the state level.
If the Court rules in favor of parental rights, states like Connecticut may be forced to change course and overturn our one-party rules and polices.
The question facing families today is simple:
Will Connecticut parents demand their rights back -- or will they wait for the Supreme Court to restore them?

I know what it looks like when a situation is about to spiral out of control — and I know the difference between a leader who steps up and one who makes everything worse. Right now, I'm watching Washington escalate the war with Iran. And I have to be honest with you — I'm deeply concerned. We have spent over twenty years and trillions of dollars on wars in the Middle East. Tens of thousands of American casualties. Hundreds of thousands of lives lost. Families shattered. Veterans who came home carrying wounds that never fully heal. Communities were left waiting for the investment that was promised to them while the money went elsewhere. And here we are again. Another Republican president. Another crisis being pushed toward military confrontation. The same elites who pushed us into war last time are back at it — and the same working families will bear the cost, in blood and in treasure, while the people making these decisions face none of the consequences. The same people who fight to cut benefits, gut the VA, and slow-walk support for our veterans are always the most eager to send our sons and daughters to war. That's not strength. That's a disgrace. _And I refuse to go to Washington and be silent about this._ Someone needs to stand up and demand answers before we are in too deep to turn back. _What is the objective? What is the plan if this escalates? And why does Washington always find money for war but never enough for the people back home?_ Those aren't radical questions. They are the basic obligations of leadership — and too few people in that building are meeting them right now. **[So, I want to know where you stand, Peter: will you add your name to our petition to demand no more blank checks for war?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126599782/605411824/-1905625658?contactdata=tOK+CC9db4S66Oxo6sKXkKFoh3T8n1fvm/rnp4g1HaiJC6h6xo7qLNMkEunckuxddfjpauYC13Sg3GF34trcYOAlVdyw7IVq5qszjMWgMFs/FV7QJYDzkp0PlmkYFvt1tLcqlMQEL+wSk+0ycEPL4/O0sbT4J5KsGuuRcAplcV0=&refcode=email_030326_iran&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAxOTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmZlMmM3NDUtZDExNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UkG5OrCM5rtlXtjYqkEQ9ngzo5dkvxjAuQLz5bboi1k=&emci=e9823d13-4817-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=bfe2c745-d117-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=19805167)** | | | | [Sign the Petition →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126599783/605411825/-1905625658?contactdata=tOK+CC9db4S66Oxo6sKXkKFoh3T8n1fvm/rnp4g1HaiJC6h6xo7qLNMkEunckuxddfjpauYC13Sg3GF34trcYOAlVdyw7IVq5qszjMWgMFs/FV7QJYDzkp0PlmkYFvt1tLcqlMQEL+wSk+0ycEPL4/O0sbT4J5KsGuuRcAplcV0=&refcode=email_030326_iran&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAxOTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmZlMmM3NDUtZDExNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=UkG5OrCM5rtlXtjYqkEQ9ngzo5dkvxjAuQLz5bboi1k=&emci=e9823d13-4817-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=bfe2c745-d117-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=19805167)

| | | | | | 47 years of Iranian terror. [Ended in one night.](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=19cd0c6299&e=567664f14c) Iranians are dancing in the streets saying "Thank you, America" — and NM's own senators are calling it reckless.

---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=211155c149&e=567664f14c)
| | 🔥 **IRAN'S REGIME FALLS — IRANIANS DANCING IN THE STREETS**
Trump and Israel took out approximately 40 of Iran's top leaders in one night. Then Trump did something nobody expected — he hacked into Iranian state television and spoke directly to the people.
A CBS reporter with deep connections inside the country says the message coming back is simple: Thank you, America. When you see the celebrations in Tehran and Georgetown, DC — old Iranian flags waving — you'll understand the scale of what just happened.
Mark makes the case that none of this happens without 2020, Butler, and everything in between. That argument will stick with you.
🚨 **HEINRICH AND LUJAN CONDEMN THE STRIKE — FETTERMAN DOESN'T**
Heinrich called it "dangerously reckless." Lujan called it "illegal." Meanwhile, an Iranian-American Democrat went on CNN and said dismantling this regime is "non-negotiable" — and that she doesn't recognize her own party right now.
Then Senator Fetterman stood up. Again. The gap between him and NM's senators gets wider every week.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=32a422b1ef&e=567664f14c)
---
| | 🕌 **IRAN BEFORE 1979 — THE PHOTOS WILL STOP YOU**
Mark walks through what Iran actually looked like before the revolution. Women in Western fashion. A modern, educated, thriving country. Then one revolution erased all of it overnight.
**He lays out five reasons Iran is positioned for the greatest comeback in the Middle East. Whether the people can seize this moment is the question that keeps you watching.
** ⚠️ **AUSTIN SHOOTING — "PROPERTY OF ALLAH" HOODIE**
Hours after the strike, a gunman opened fire at a bar in Austin. Two dead, fourteen wounded. He was wearing a hoodie that said "Property of Allah" and an undershirt with Iranian imagery. The FBI is investigating it as potential terrorism. The sleeper cell conversation just got very real.

#### Teichert in the Trenches - March 2026
Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs!
It has been a rewarding and impact-filled month! Please follow along on my social media and YouTube page for up-to-date thoughts as the war in Iran continues. ** _Teichert in the News_**
---
Iran dominated the month of news. Here are a few clips leading up to the strikes and after the strikes began.
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/t17dCuo8GtbY)

It was a thrill to join Brian Kilmeade on Fox & Friends to discuss the military build up in the Middle East (February 20).
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/Vco4vISX8Qa7)
---
I enjoyed this thorough interview from Kellie Meyer (filling in for Leland Vittert) from the 20th of February. In retrospect, credible sources now indicate that the strikes were initially going to start on February 21st, but weather caused them to be delayed a week.

| [ ](https://eufi5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm8pYvztcepEnLSksS/BPi-A-W290Bv)
---

Let's talk about carbs. That word alone has launched a thousand diet wars. Some people treat carbohydrates like they're the devil, while others treat kale like it's a religion. Most Americans are stuck somewhere in the middle--confused, tired, inflamed, and wondering why eating a bagel makes them want to take a nap until Thursday.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.GSPpAjBlVDLetL6JL3cLcg_wcS99ntzrAr1Va1FQMaE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=189874239)
Here's the truth: carbs aren't the enemy, but _mindless carbs_ are. The real conversation isn't just about carbohydrates themselves...it's about what those carbs are doing inside your gut. Because once you understand that connection, you level up. Fiber isn't just roughage to help you poop--it's microbiome control.
Welcome behind the curtain.
**Your Gut Is a Garden (Not a Trash Can)**
Most people eat like their stomach is a furnace: calories in, calories out. But your gut is not just a calorie-processing tube. It's a living ecosystem, filled with trillions of bacteria that make up your microbiome. These microbes influence far more than digestion--they influence inflammation, immune function, cravings, insulin sensitivity, mood, and even brain health. You're not just feeding yourself when you eat...you're feeding an entire internal community.
The real question is simple: are you feeding the right bugs?
**Fiber Is Not About Calories -- It's About Bacteria**
Here's what most people don't know: humans don't actually digest fiber. Your bacteria do. And when those microbes break fiber down, they produce powerful compounds called short-chain fatty acids, especially one called **butyrate**. Butyrate is gut-healing rocket fuel. It strengthens the gut lining, reduces inflammation, improves metabolic health, and supports immune balance. So, when people say, "I need more fiber," what they often really mean is that they need a healthier internal ecosystem.
That's the smart play.
**Not All Fiber Feeds the Same Bugs**
The next layer of insight is this: different fibers feed different bacteria. Fiber isn't one single thing...it's a toolbox. When you start understanding the categories of smart carbs and how they shape your microbiome, you gain a level of control over health, appetite, and inflammation that most people never even realize exists. Let's break down the Smart Carb categories.
**1\. Prebiotic Fibers: Fertilizer for the Good Guys**
Prebiotics are fibers that selectively feed beneficial bacteria like _Bifidobacteria_. Think of them as fertilizer for your best gut bugs.
**Top prebiotic sources include:**
* Garlic
* Onions
* Leeks
* Asparagus
* Jerusalem artichokes

These foods help strengthen digestion, immune signaling, and gut barrier integrity. A simple coaching tip is to include these strategically on **Phase 2 and Phase 3 days** to keep your gut ecosystem thriving.
**2\. Resistant Starch: The Butyrate Builder**
Resistant starch is one of the most fascinating smart carb tools because it resists digestion in the small intestine and becomes food for bacteria in the colon. This is one of the primary ways you grow butyrate-producing microbes.
**Best resistant starch sources include:**
* Cooled potatoes
* Cooled rice
* Green bananas
* Plantains

Here's the key: a freshly cooked potato is absorbed quickly and can act more like a fast carb. But when you cook it and then cool it, the starch structure changes into resistant starch, making it far more microbiome friendly.
Same food, different preparation, totally different metabolic effect.
**3\. Polyphenol-Rich Plants: Diversity Builders**
Polyphenols are protective plant compounds that support microbiome diversity and cellular health. These foods help combat oxidative stress, reduce chronic inflammation, and support heart and brain function. Polyphenols protect your cells from damage and may lower the risk of chronic diseases like diabetes and even certain cancers.
A simple rule of thumb is that deeply colored fruits and vegetables are often nature's signal for high polyphenol content.
**Top polyphenol-rich sources include:**
* Blueberries, blackberries, elderberries
* Dark chocolate (high cacao)
* Extra virgin olive oil
* Herbs and spices
* Red cabbage and spinach
* Fermented soy like tempeh

Polyphenols are like sending your gut microbiome to the gym--more resilience, more balance.
**4\. FEL Smart Gut Strategy: Fiber Anchors**
These are the drivers of Smart Carbs--the foods that improve fullness, blood sugar stability, and long-term gut strength.
**FEL gut anchors include:**
* Avocados
* Broccoli
* Brussels sprouts
* Chia seeds
* Flaxseed

These foods fit beautifully into the Fast.Eat.Live. phasing system because they build metabolic flexibility without inducing cravings or energy swings.
**What About Beans and Legumes?**
Beans are interesting. They're high in fiber, and they can absolutely feed beneficial gut bacteria. But here's the full story: many people with IBS or gut dysfunction struggle with legumes. High quantities can cause bloating, discomfort, gas, and fermentation overload. Beans turn me into a whoopie cushion. Oohwee!
So, the answer isn't "beans are bad." The answer is that the dose matters, the person matters, and the gut matters.
**Smart Carbs vs. Dumb Carbs**
Smart carbs feed beneficial bacteria, improve insulin sensitivity, reduce inflammation, increase satiety, and support long-term health.
Dumb carbs do the opposite.
Ultra-processed flour, sugar bombs, seed-oil fried snacks, and "gluten-free" cookies that don't build resilience--they feed dysfunction.
Your gut bugs know the difference. Feed sugar bugs and you crave sugar. Feed fiber bugs and you crave real food.
**Final Takeaway: Feed the Bugs That Build You**
Your gut is always listening, whether you realize it or not. Every meal you eat is a signal, and every fiber source you choose is either building resilience inside your microbiome or quietly feeding dysfunction. That's why the goal isn't to fear carbohydrates--it's to understand them. When you choose smart carbs and fiber-rich foods with intention, you're feeding the right gut bugs, strengthening your internal ecosystem, and supporting everything from energy and mood to appetite control, digestion, and long-term longevity.
That's the _[Fast.Eat.Live](https://substack.com/redirect/2c5a0df2-18a3-48d8-96f4-c4fc91ca8c1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ difference: nutrition that works _with_ your body, not against it.
