subject: This cannot go unanswered
body:
DHS admits that in less than a year, 261 DACA recipients have been detained. | | | Peter, DACA was meant to protect immigrant youth from detention and deportation. But new information confirms what our communities have been experiencing — **261 DACA recipients illegally detained and 86 deported.** _And that’s only from January to November of 2025._ This latest information is the first admission through government data of the alarming rise in DACA recipients with valid status being targeted and detained by federal immigration agents from ICE and CBP across the country. It also comes while the federal government continues to pressure DACA recipients to self-deport. **DACA recipients — our coworkers, friends, and classmates — are continuing to be detained and cruelly separated from their families.** Meanwhile, the DACA program continues to be attacked in courts, with efforts in Texas to sever DACA recipients’ access to work permits. The full breadth of the administration’s refusal to follow the law as it pertains to the DACA program and the deportation protections it enshrines wasn’t known until now. **We will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country.** [**We need your help fueling our advocacy efforts. Can you make a donation to United We Dream today? clean_body: DHS admits that in less than a year, 261 DACA recipients have been detained. | | | Peter, DACA was meant to protect immigrant youth from detention and deportation. But new information confirms what our communities have been experiencing — 261 DACA recipients illegally detained and 86 deported. And that’s only from January to November of 2025. This latest information is the first admission through government data of the alarming rise in DACA recipients with valid status being targeted and detained by federal immigration agents from ICE and CBP across the country. It also comes while the federal government continues to pressure DACA recipients to self-deport. DACA recipients — our coworkers, friends, and classmates — are continuing to be detained and cruelly separated from their families. Meanwhile, the DACA program continues to be attacked in courts, with efforts in Texas to sever DACA recipients’ access to work permits. The full breadth of the administration’s refusal to follow the law as it pertains to the DACA program and the deportation protections it enshrines wasn’t known until now. We will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country. body:
James Talarico just won his primary in Texas. He is the Democratic Nominee for Senate. The Republicans are going into a brutal run off election to decide between John Cornyn and Ken Paxton.
#

Peter, it's Ruben.
You know we need to win back the Senate this November. Majorities in Congress are the only way we're going to bring our country back from the brink.
What you might not know is that the Senate map this year is _extremely_ difficult. In a normal year, we probably wouldn’t have a shot. But this isn’t a normal year.
James Talarico just won his primary in Texas. He is our nominee for Senate. The Republicans are going into a brutal run off election to decide between John Cornyn and Ken Paxton. What all of that means here is that we have a massive opportunity for a pickup... but it won’t be easy.
I know a thing or two about winning tough Senate races, and I know James can win this race. Texas is in play in 2026, and he needs all the help he can get. So, now that James is our nominee, I’m making a humble request.

# 1\. [The Supreme Court promised a review of med-mal jurisdictional rules. It never happened.](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c43e0fe6f3&e=b7b3eddce2)
_By Seth Higgins_ Last Thursday, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court released an order stating that the Civil Procedural Rules Committee, which advises the Court, did not have to reexamine the impact of the 2023 repeal of Rule 1006(a.1), outside the normal procedure of requesting a rules amendment. This came despite an earlier order stating that the Committee “shall reexamine” the 2022 rule amendments two years after their effective date. The rule that was repealed previously limited the venue of medical malpractice lawsuits. Matters of civil procedure and venue usually do not garner much attention. This, however, was a monumental decision. The explanation for canceling this analysis offered by the Court is dubious, at best. **Why It Matters.** Rule 1006(a.1) came about because of a[ _healthcare crisis_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=38110193dd&e=b7b3eddce2) in Pennsylvania in the 1990s. The situation was partially caused by the ability of plaintiffs to file medical malpractice suits in counties outside of where the alleged harm occurred. This legal environment allowed trial lawyers to rush to[ _plaintiff-friendly_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2657c3615d&e=b7b3eddce2) courtrooms and jury pools, particularly[ _Philadelphia_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1e16adadce&e=b7b3eddce2). As a result, medical malpractice premiums spiked. Patients paid the price. Medical care became increasingly expensive. Some doctors left the state or retired earlier. For the doctors that remained, they adopted a[ _defensive, litigation-sensitive approach to medicine_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=281875b1aa&e=b7b3eddce2). The legislature fixed the problem, but the Supreme Court undid their work. Now, healthcare costs are rising again and no one on the court or the Rules Committee will even tell the people why. [_Continue Reading_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2bfbad78bc&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
# 2\. [A classic Trump performance](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6929130ac5&e=b7b3eddce2)
_By Thom Nickels_

I watched President Trump’s State of the Union address from start to finish, realizing that no matter how good it was, Democrats would grumble and find fault. Yet one of the first things that struck me about the speech was the president’s articulate and confident command of the language, and his straightforward manner of delivery. Democrats lately have been toying with the lie that Trump’s mental capabilities are on the decline. They have been making all sorts of accusations about his cognitive abilities, insisting that his speeches and comments are splintered and illogical and follow a zigzag path. **Why It Matters.** The most egregious episode of the evening was when Trump challenged every lawmaker to stand if they believe their first duty is to protect American citizens rather than illegal aliens. The Democrats — with the eyes of the nation watching — remained seated. “These people are crazy. I’m telling you, they’re crazy,” Trump said moments later. “Democrats are destroying our country.” This was not Trumpian hyperbole. Ryan James Girdusky, a GOP strategist, commented that the Democratic preference for illegal aliens over American citizens was a major misstep. “A billion dollar ad (for the midterms) just wrote itself because they wouldn’t stand,” he said. Democrats have nothing to offer the American people except, as Speaker Johnson mentioned in November of last year, “A woke and weak form of government.” That means re-opening the border so millions more illegal aliens can flood the country; resurrecting DEI, the defund the police movement, and kickstarting a host of social justice movements like BLM and trans ideology in the schools and military. **Counterpoint?** Jeff Hurvitz [_also wrote_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=434e01e0ab&e=b7b3eddce2) about the State of the Union for _Broad + Liberty_ this week, and his impression was different. “The most recent incarnations have become promotional pieces for administrations. President Trump spent much time celebrating the gold medal-earning U.S. Olympic teams’ success. A great achievement for sure. But where was the mention of a real battle threatening to take place, as U.S. warships threaten to fire upon Iran? The country needed to hear about the rationale of this. Also, it needed a factual look at our economy, as prices have gone up. And while war heroes were properly introduced, where was the mention of U.S. citizens whose lives were taken by ICE agents?” **Continue reading** Thom’s piece [_here_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=10f9868a19&e=b7b3eddce2) and Jeff’s [_here_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3060ebe146&e=b7b3eddce2).

# 4\. What we're reading
It seems like the 2024 election just ended, but the 2026 midterms effectively began yesterday with primaries in Texas, North Carolina, and elsewhere. Yes, election season never really ends. Texas Democrats nominated a Presbyterian seminarian who nonetheless holds far-left cultural views, while Republicans will have to go another round in May to decide between state AG Ken Paxton and incumbent Senator John Cornyn. Jeff Blehar at _National Review_ gives [_his take_](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=28298fbbcd&e=b7b3eddce2) on what he says is a “a mess it is for the Republican Party.”

**“Here, right matters.”**
That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States.
[ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxS_soLdYbrCLjD0UB6GL_JOqMsSxGZUeJ6-X0LAE-P3BN_1dq2n09AVfDM-AQzr8GQW7S2fLZ8cAvjaXcx-t1AKmOuXOETxuK4Kuywu39teni8LasHXgw4TC46Kmi4xpUb6HHyeYMmGoSI-UuKHYucBF2isjwQGt7OO6A87vteDehwPoIEmkZl7HQO2gzU84aQiQl-nZE9lhONx5n81SZiDjogjgXl0Urx7SZp8VV6f3/4on/urlsoo9MSZ6XGPfSNJmeQQ/h0/h001.jDI2cylDthS4Bmfzu5qxi8wqvIGSgq6GulYvQrXYlcg)

It’s Retired Lieutenant Colonel Alex Vindman. I never intended to be in the national spotlight. I joined the Army and served for 21 years because I wanted to fight and defend the country I love. I could have never expected that it would lead me to testify against the President of the United States.
_That is, until I heard the president try to extort a foreign country into investigating a political rival — a quid pro quo._
I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It was my duty to report the corruption.
I knew that I was assuming a lot of risk by challenging the most powerful person in the world. There was no doubt that he was going to use everything in his power to retaliate, just as he’d done to his opponents in the past.
[**But I had confidence that I could tell the truth. I knew that this is America — and here, right matters. That’s why I am asking you to split a donation between my Senate campaign and the Nevada State Democratic Party before my fundraising deadline.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvbs9zJH3bzXGa-Qxcdd9sQDaabyraFyuPU4Ron_9N7of9IPkxYBPvujXgQ-0ud1vtJWiY0g6SaQVZlBgcwN4KPb7EzPLlJcpR-CUW48-jwWi_PnE8cdX6-kvdeDVeoWPcfFwKkDXAX6WVMSX8SB9SC594giL3vFUjRJKTq8pkwvRoUxi2V8rdFfS7nYc5vtWkqpjRcHHqVPUGLUVFX5mlZkpTXjVGZMkl9SSOzDL7XcGRypkwiQzeRTFwvpJ_F80_7DH--T_98uKDOxJlO7prRQfZ2xLUUHpMT2ysbLWHTV6QuUCIluy1tuWT6ISEBUypvXiJFCnP8FZwU00stZ_gz3yXYe0Cb6_M8U7uGnTUVAA/4on/urlsoo9MSZ6XGPfSNJmeQQ/h1/h001.PhJLxXEIsA6Pt_R5xUfeptFKdPsjMEacFxJgJfMdCJE)

A lot has happened since that day in 2019. President Trump exacted his revenge by firing me and calling me “human scum.” He tried to incite an insurrection to hold onto power after losing a fair election. Now, he is using his powers in office to inflict violence on American citizens.
Amidst all of this I still believe that right matters.
Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past but we’ve overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union.
We are in the middle of another fight for our country right now. I still have faith that good can prevail over evil and that we can overcome these hard times. What is right still matters here...but only if we make it matter.
**That’s why I have decided to run for the United States Senate in Florida. We are taking the fight straight to Donald Trump in his own backyard. A win here will deliver Democrats control of the Senate.**

clean_body: | | | | “Here, right matters.” That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States. It’s Retired Lieutenant Colonel Alex Vindman. I never intended to be in the national spotlight. I joined the Army and served for 21 years because I wanted to fight and defend the country I love. I could have never expected that it would lead me to testify against the President of the United States. That is, until I heard the president try to extort a foreign country into investigating a political rival — a quid pro quo. I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It was my duty to report the corruption. I knew that I was assuming a lot of risk by challenging the most powerful person in the world. There was no doubt that he was going to use everything in his power to retaliate, just as he’d done to his opponents in the past. A lot has happened since that day in 2019. President Trump exacted his revenge by firing me and calling me “human scum.” He tried to incite an insurrection to hold onto power after losing a fair election. Now, he is using his powers in office to inflict violence on American citizens. Amidst all of this I still believe that right matters. Our country has lived through challenging periods in the past but we’ve overcome, persevered, and moved towards a more perfect union. We are in the middle of another fight for our country right now. I still have faith that good can prevail over evil and that we can overcome these hard times. What is right still matters here...but only if we make it matter. That’s why I have decided to run for the United States Senate in Florida. We are taking the fight straight to Donald Trump in his own backyard. A win here will deliver Democrats control of the Senate. subject: I will be facing Greg Abbott this November
body:
Texans are ready for a governor who works for them.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
We did it, Peter!
**Because of your support, we cleared the first hurdle, and I will officially be facing Greg Abbott this November in the race for Governor of Texas.**
Now the real work begins. Over the next eight months, my team and I will travel across Texas to share our message, talk with voters about what is at stake, and build the kind of campaign that can win. That means scaling up our field program, expanding voter contact, and getting our message on TV and online so Texans hear the truth, not Abbott’s lies.
And if there’s anything this primary election showed us, it’s that Texans are already showing up. More Democrats voted than Republicans during the first week of early voting in the primary, and turnout was higher than it has been in years.
Texans are paying attention, and they’re ready for a governor with integrity who works for them, not against them.
But we can’t take anything for granted. To win in November, we have to turn that energy into a statewide movement, starting right now.
**[So I am asking: can you help us kick off this race on the right foot by becoming a General Election Founding Donor and pitching in $5 today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260304_1_official.93-ke6&refcode=em20260304-701&amount=5&t=1&akid=701%2E299639%2EmOMWdb)**

Thank you for your support, Peter. Let’s win this, together.
— Gina Hinojosa

# Hi Everyone!

---
| |
**Registered Dems: Caucus is here!**
**Just two days left: March 4th, or 5th for one hour in the evening.****Find your exact Caucus location/date/time**[**here**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=6cee7d3cc9&e=738470dca6)
**Feel free to call/text me/email me if you have a problem****(respond to this email for my number)**
**We were able to help a group of delegates get into a Caucus location last night.**
**Become a delegate and stop by our table <3****If you have a hat or button make sure to wear it.****We will have buttons at our table.********Become a delegate at Caucus so that you can vote for me at County Assembly on Saturday, March 14th.**
**Make sure you have a progressive option on the ballot in June.****I need 30% of the vote to get on the ballot, the other two front runners are petitioning on and only need 10% of the vote to get on the ballot.**
**The wind is shifting. We need real progressive policies to address systemic issues. I know it’s scary to vote for change when we are so used to just hearing platitudes.**
**However:** Data for Progress finds that 65% of voters support Medicare for All People hate AI and data centersPeople want integrity in office and are sick of big moneyThe only reason these policies are thought of as impossible is because big money and corporations define what is possible.******If you vote for me, you will have a Rep in Congress fighting for:** Universal healthcareAffordable housingGood union jobsAbolishing ICERemoving TrumpBig money out of politicsRegulating AI & Big TechAccountability for IsraelThe Green New Deal****
**We can have a government that works for the people.****A government that focuses on policies that help people instead of enriching corporations and the ultra wealthy.**
**Mayor Mamdani is proving that progressive, people first policies make life better.****After the blizzard hit the East Coast last week, his government paid people $30 an hour to shovel snow and in return the entire NYC community benefits and enjoys shoveled sidewalks.**
**This is how good governance works.**
**It puts people first.**
**I hope to have your support at Caucus.**
**Let’s move El Paso County forward and finally get representation with integrity in Congress.**
**With care,****Zuri Horowitz**
**I have taken the Integrity Index Pledge:** No corporate PAC moneyStock trading ban for CongressClose the revolving doorOverturn Citizens United
**Additionally:** Zuri does not hold (own) any stocks99% of donations are from individuals1% of donation are from Zuri71% of donations are from Coloradans
**I am a proud Courage Candidate:****Part of a slate of future leaders who are aligned on a pro-democracy platform that includes:** Pro-impeachmentAnti-CorruptionAnti-OligarchyAnti-Authoritarianism
**I am also endorsed by the Center for Freethought Equality:** The Center for Freethought Equality advocates for issues the humanist and atheist community cares about like the separation of church and state, protecting civil liberties, and advancing progressive policies. Humanism is a progressive philosophy of life that, without theism and other supernatural beliefs, affirms our ability and responsibility to lead ethical lives of personal fulfillment that aspire to the greater good of humanity.
**Because of Trump and Israel’s attack on Iran: 1045 people have reportedly been killed including 153 school girls, six American services members have also been killed **Contact [Hickenlooper](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=a934f26e5b&e=738470dca6), [Bennet](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=1c9f10e06a&e=738470dca6), and [Crank](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=0aa083c463&e=738470dca6) to ask that they vote in support of a War Powers Resolution that would block the U.S. from further military action.
We can not have another forever war. We need to invest in our country and our citizens instead of bombing other countries.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hey folks,
Katie Phang joined me from New York, and we just let it rip. We got into Trump's illegal war in Iran, and we didn't sugarcoat it. American lives lost. No clear plan. And a White House that feels like it's improvising with missiles. The polling. The MAGA cracks. The fear. The corruption.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* [**00:01:07**] We break down the new CNN poll: 59% disapprove of Trump's war in Iran, 60% say he has no plan, and 62% believe Congress should've authorized it. In this partisan climate, those numbers matter.
* [**00:05:21**] Nick Fuentes telling his followers to vote Democrat. Megyn Kelly turning on Trump. When the MAGA echo chamber starts fracturing, you know something's wrong.
* [**00:08:47**] Is this a distraction from Epstein and the tanking economy -- or is it worse than that? We talk about the chaos inside this administration and the total lack of a coherent strategy.
* [**00:12:06**] Katie raises the nuclear nightmare scenario: if you corner Iran like this with no endgame, what's their rational move? Escalation. Proliferation. That's how you make the world less safe.
* [**00:17:39**] I share an update on my surgery after losing 300 pounds -- and why this next chapter is going to dramatically improve my life.

This conversation is about more than foreign policy. It's about accountability. It's about whether American lives are treated like props. It's about corruption hiding in plain sight. And it's about what we can actually do next -- harm reduction, winning back ground in 2026, and staying focused when everything feels chaotic. Michele's early credits include singing classic songs for the Maranatha! Music Praise albums, I, II, III, IV and V in the 70's and early 80's. Her radio hit single with Phil Keaggy, "What a Wonder" led to her recording contract and three solo records for Sparrow in the 80's came after. Together, Michele's record sales total over 2 million. She also charted with her album, "Love Makes All The Difference" in the 90's and in 2005 recorded the Christmas album, "I Hear Angels Calling." The single still tops airplay for AC Pop stations like Nashville's Mix 92.9, every year.
'Untangled' is the story of how God helped unravel the hurt and hopelessness that had Michele tangled up for so long.
Michele toured with The Billy Graham Assoc. singing for massive crusades and toured up to two hundred concert dates a year at one time. These days, her Facebook platform has reached over 20 million on any given week and her "Two Minute Miracle" video Bible devotional each day, (Mon-Fri) is viewed by 40,000 viewers or greater each week. Michele's Facebook demographic is people 18-25, all the way up to those in their 50's and upward. She appeared on The Dr. Phil Show in 2021 and over 3 million people watched as Michele and Dr. Phil talked about her book, her life and how God heals a human life.

Music Praise albums, I, II, III, IV and V in the 70's and early 80's. Her radio hit single with Phil Keaggy, "What a Wonder" led to her recording contract and three solo records for Sparrow in the 80's came after. Together, Michele's record sales total over 2 million. She also charted with her album, "Love Makes All The Difference" in the 90's and in 2005 recorded the Christmas album, "I Hear Angels Calling." The single still tops airplay for AC Pop stations like Nashville's Mix 92.9, every year. 'Untangled' is the story of how God helped unravel the hurt and hopelessness that had Michele tangled up for so long. Michele toured with The Billy Graham Assoc. singing for massive crusades and toured up to two hundred concert dates a year at one time. These days, her Facebook platform has reached over 20 million on any given week and her "Two Minute Miracle" video Bible devotional each day, (Mon-Fri) is viewed by 40,000 viewers or greater each week. Michele's Facebook demographic is people 18-25, all the way up to those in their 50's and upward. She appeared on The Dr. Phil Show in 2021 and over 3 million people watched as Michele and Dr. Phil talked about her book, her life and how God heals a human life. name: American Action News
subject: 10 Paradoxes of Our Age
body:
Have you noticed how our world seems full of contradictions lately?

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs8jm36a3s8m1ve8sikaeb1nt26mtqaj1d7v0nk8_rp22sh2s8i6epr2cdhmaoj6cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how our world seems full of contradictions lately?
Prosperity is rising. Yet freedom, in many places, is retreating.

Global diplomacy expands. But so do threats.

Cultural traditions persist. Still, they're strained by mass migration and ideological division.
---
|
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4choc91414pr6dvbo4knoni41ohi9r2j708mom0_rp22sh2s8i6epr2cdhmaoj6cdh2bs)
---
| | These aren't just abstract concepts--they're reshaping the world we live in right now.

And if we don't understand them, we risk misunderstanding the forces at work and misjudging our response.

That's why the Hoover Institution is sharing a **powerful new analysis from Senior Fellow Victor Davis Hanson:_Ten Paradoxes of Our Age_.**

In it, he outlines ten defining paradoxes of our time, including:
* Why economic growth doesn't always bring political freedom
* How diplomacy can coexist with rising global insecurity
* What happens when cultural pressures outpace integration

Whether you're concerned about America's future role in the world or seeking clarity amid global confusion, this piece offers a timely perspective.

These paradoxes are reshaping our world, and understanding them is crucial.

"If we do not understand the paradoxes of our age, we will continue to be confused by the outcomes." -- Victor Davis Hanson

**Download your free copy of '_Ten Paradoxes of Our Age_ ' now and gain the insights you need to navigate our complex world.**

Access your free copy today: [https://resources.hoover.org/ten-paradoxes-of-our-age](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr3mccrgb6vceh0psn3deds0tdbhi0cgipmoajp0_rp22sh2s8i6epr2cdhmaoj6cdh2bs)Greg

body:
| | Peter – Marie is more committed than ever to delivering solutions that lower costs for families and tackling the everyday expenses that are squeezing people dry.

[She needs to hear directly from you about what’s hitting your household the hardest so she can keep pushing for practical, bipartisan solutions that reflect real life, not partisan talking points. Will you take a minute to fill out our quick survey? →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126640960/605527175/1182309762?refcode=MGP_EM_SV_90DO_260304_2_2&refcode2=f34e5e1f-f617-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzRlNWUxZi1mNjE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xnXhRURbuC2Ie48WUnuDmkhviIPUcSeWXYyy1i4SZhg=&emci=e56b7d88-f417-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=f34e5e1f-f617-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=31138575)

Thanks for taking the time to weigh in.

– Team MGP
* * *
_Previous Message from Marie Gluesenkamp Perez:_

Peter,

Everywhere I go across the district, I hear similar concerns: grocery prices are up, utility bills are up, health insurance premiums are climbing, and childcare is so expensive that many parents feel like they’re working just to pay the daycare bill.

Families and everyday people here and nationwide are doing everything they can to make ends meet, but the deck isn’t stacked in their favor. It feels like the basics are slipping further and further out of reach.

[I’m tackling the affordability crisis head-on and deliver solutions wherever possible, but to keep this work going, I need to hear directly from you about what’s hitting your household the hardest. Will you take a minute to fill out our quick survey? →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126640961/605527177/1182309762?refcode=MGP_EM_SV_90DO_260304_2_2&refcode2=f34e5e1f-f617-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzRlNWUxZi1mNjE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xnXhRURbuC2Ie48WUnuDmkhviIPUcSeWXYyy1i4SZhg=&emci=e56b7d88-f417-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=f34e5e1f-f617-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=31138575)
| **[SHARE YOUR THOUGHTS](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126640963/605527179/1182309762?refcode=MGP_EM_SV_90DO_260304_2_2&refcode2=f34e5e1f-f617-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzRlNWUxZi1mNjE3LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xnXhRURbuC2Ie48WUnuDmkhviIPUcSeWXYyy1i4SZhg=&emci=e56b7d88-f417-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=f34e5e1f-f617-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=31138575)**
---

Peter, I deeply understand the struggles working families in Southwest Washington face because I’ve faced them myself.

My husband and I went without health insurance for a long time, and I used to carry my toddler around on my hip while working in our auto shop, because health coverage and childcare were simply out of our budget.

That’s why I introduced legislation to expand access to quality childcare in rural areas, and protect affordable healthcare. I’m also addressing affordability with my “Right to Repair” work, ensuring ordinary people can fix their own stuff – whether it’s a car or household appliance – and make it last instead of being forced to buy cheap, disposable replacements.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022526_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022526_1]
Peter,
My name is Mary Peltola, and I want to share with you why I've made the decision to run for the United States Senate in Alaska — and to ask for your support as we begin this journey together.
But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign, please use this link to split a contribution today:
secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola/founding-donor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022526_1]
CHIP IN NOW >>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2026-peltola?refcode=022526_1]
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. They don’t even believe us.
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.
So I am asking:
Please contribute to my campaign for the U.S. Senate and Outrage then Action PAC today to become a Founding Donor. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. They will all add up fast. Hey Derek —

Texas is now on the map — don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.

Now, I know we have burned in Texas before by placing our hopes in the
Lone Star State.

But with your help, this may be just the year we finally start winning in
Texas. And that’s because of a super-talented U.S. Senate candidate named
James Talarico.

You may have heard of James when he appeared on the Colbert Show — or
didn’t appear, because the network bowed to political pressure from
Trump’s FCC to try to deny him a platform (he was on the online version of
the show instead).

But he is a State Senator in Texas with a great story to tell, and a
remarkable appeal to a broad cross-section of voters in that state.

Well, he just won a hotly contested primary with another Democratic
superstar, Jasmine Crockett, and will go on to the general election. And
while the Democratic primary is over, the Republicans are in an ugly,
costly runoff to determine their nominee. This gives us a unique
opportunity to elect James to the Senate this fall.

A new Strength in Numbers/Verasight poll is sounding the alarm: the people
have had enough of a Supreme Court that is broken, partisan, and
unaccountable.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260304.NNn14F&refcode=em20260304-61222&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=61222%2E1407376%2E9tlsRI ]Strength in Numbers/Verasight poll

65% of respondents support term limits for Supreme Court justices, and
majorities across every political group (Democrats, independents, and even
Republicans) agree.

People are fed up with a Court where lifetime appointments allow a handful
of justices to shape our country for generations.

Why does this matter? Because trust in the Court is crumbling.

Conservatives have weaponized lifetime appointments to push decisions like
Dobbs, while some justices have taken undisclosed luxury trips and gifts
from billionaires — a damning pattern of corruption and partisanship.

The people are ready for change: term limits, expanding the Court, and
reforms to stop any president from packing the bench for life.

That’s where Demand Justice PAC comes in. We mobilize, fight, and put
pressure for structural reforms that restore accountability and fairness
to the Court. But we can’t do it alone.

# **[Trump pledges safe middle east oil transit with US Navy escort](https://substack.com/redirect/5dfeea30-45ef-4614-8ef5-3f95f0eef95e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
President Donald Trump pledged Tuesday the United States **[will guarantee safe passage of oil from the Middle East](https://substack.com/redirect/5dfeea30-45ef-4614-8ef5-3f95f0eef95e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid ongoing war with Iran that has killed hundreds and roiled global markets, announcing insurance guarantees and potential US Navy escorts through the Strait of Hormuz to prevent an energy crisis.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5dfeea30-45ef-4614-8ef5-3f95f0eef95e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Navy escorts planned:** US Navy will begin escorting tankers through strategic Strait of Hormuz as soon as necessary.
* **Insurance offered cheap:** US International Development Finance Corporation to provide political risk insurance at reasonable price for Gulf trade.
* **War deaths mount:** Hundreds dead in Iran dozens elsewhere six US servicemen killed five days into conflict.
* **Markets calm briefly:** Brent crude up 1.8 percent S&P 500 futures rise 0.3 percent gold above 5100 dollars.

### **[Oil steadies on Trump tanker pledge](https://substack.com/redirect/f7578ed6-e1e0-47dc-9305-c83de304885e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Oil prices held steady Wednesday after President Trump **[promised US insurance guarantees and potential Navy escorts](https://substack.com/redirect/f7578ed6-e1e0-47dc-9305-c83de304885e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for tankers through the Strait of Hormuz where traffic had dropped to zero due to Iran war fears, easing earlier surges that pushed Brent to 84 dollars.
* **Hormuz traffic halts:** One fifth of global oil supply stalled as shippers fear attacks insurance dries up.
* **DFC insurance immediate:** United States Development Finance Corporation offers political risk cover at reasonable price.
* **Brent eases from peak:** Brent crude oil is at $82 dollars after hitting $84 WTI oil falls to $74 dollars.

# [Trump backs crypto over banks in titanic battle](https://substack.com/redirect/d7b3e13a-2023-47b6-a571-dfd80542871a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump **[publicly sided with crypto firms](https://substack.com/redirect/d7b3e13a-2023-47b6-a571-dfd80542871a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tuesday in their fight against banks over allowing yields on stablecoins, warning the Genius Act is being undermined and urging banks to make a good deal because it serves the American people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d7b3e13a-2023-47b6-a571-dfd80542871a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Legislation threatened:** Banks blocking passage of companion Clarity Act over stable coin yield issue.
* **Coinbase shares surge:** Up as much as 15 percent while JPMorgan and Bank of America dip.
* **Banks fear 6.6 trillion:** Treasury study warns stable coin yields could drain deposits and destabilize smaller banks.
* **Trump family crypto ties:** President and family generated hundreds of millions from crypto interests.

### **[US and Britain split on crypto rules](https://substack.com/redirect/eba5a6ee-8cd0-4610-adcf-aedb166ba0de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
British and US regulators **[are divided over testing blockchain versions of securities](https://substack.com/redirect/eba5a6ee-8cd0-4610-adcf-aedb166ba0de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Britain pushing a cautious sandbox approach while the US favors exemptive relief in talks aimed at boosting crypto collaboration under a joint taskforce launched last September.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eba5a6ee-8cd0-4610-adcf-aedb166ba0de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Sandbox obstacle emerges:** Britain wants controlled testing environment for tokenized securities US SEC expresses doubts on viability.
* **Stablecoins align broadly:** Both sides agree on harmonizing rules for stable coins backed by actual currencies.
* **Pro crypto US shift:** Trump administration easing regulation encouraging adoption contrasts with the UK Bank of England's caution.
* **British FCA defends testing:** Claims sandbox testing is valuable for understanding risks opportunities while maintaining trust integrity.

# [Bitcoin surges past $73,000 dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/20409da9-f735-4c69-abe7-b2bd4637e505?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bitcoin rallied as much as 7.73 percent to top $73,890 dollars Wednesday rebounding from Middle East conflict selloff with spot Bitcoin ETFs seeing more than $680 million dollars in inflows over two days as investors treated crypto as a temporary safe haven.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/20409da9-f735-4c69-abe7-b2bd4637e505?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ether joins rally:** Ether up 9.17 percent to $2,140 dollars as the entire crypto market turns green.
* **ETF inflows surge:** Spot Bitcoin ETFs rake in over 680 million dollars Monday and Tuesday.
* **Outperforms gold:** Bitcoin up 11.84 percent since Friday while gold down almost 2 percent.
* **Still below peak:** Bitcoin remains 40 percent off October high despite rebound.

# [Bessent's promises Gulf action plan for oil transport](https://substack.com/redirect/1b1c15b1-4cc2-4afe-907c-b97acc9a98cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Oil prices steadied Wednesday with US crude at $74.68 dollars and Brent at $81.77 dollars after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent **[promised further White House announcements to support tanker traffic](https://substack.com/redirect/1b1c15b1-4cc2-4afe-907c-b97acc9a98cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the Persian Gulf amid the Iran war.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1b1c15b1-4cc2-4afe-907c-b97acc9a98cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strait traffic standstill:** 20 percent of global oil supply blocked as owners fear Iranian strikes.
* **Multiple announcements coming:** Bessent confirms series of measures beyond initial DFC insurance.
* **WTI jumps then calms:** Rose 6 percent Monday, 5 percent Tuesday but are now up only 0.16 percent.
* **Hormuz chokepoint critical** Millions of barrels have been stranded after Revolutionary Guard threatened attacks.

### **[Bessent: 15 percent tarrifs this week are coming](https://substack.com/redirect/2b926af8-6323-435f-90be-3fbde3c04745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Wednesday President Trump's 15 percent global tariff[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/2b926af8-6323-435f-90be-3fbde3c04745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[will likely begin this week rising from the current 10 percent](https://substack.com/redirect/2b926af8-6323-435f-90be-3fbde3c04745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and predicted rates will return to pre-Supreme Court levels within five months using more robust authorities.
* **Section 122 tariffs:** Replacement duties under Trade Act of 1974 can last only 150 days without Congress.
* **Supreme Court struck IEEPA:** February ruling blocked Trump's original unilateral reciprocal tariffs.
* **Trade studies underway:** USTR and Commerce Department completing work for stronger future measures.
* **Back to old rates:** Bessent believes fulsome authorities will restore previous levels by August.

* * *
# [Defense firms drop Claude AI](https://substack.com/redirect/6018b96b-47bf-4ab9-b6f9-693a7895f7b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Multiple defense tech companies have ordered employees to **[stop using Anthropic's Claude and switch to other models](https://substack.com/redirect/6018b96b-47bf-4ab9-b6f9-693a7895f7b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the Pentagon blacklisted the company last week, citing supply chain risks despite no official written ban.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6018b96b-47bf-4ab9-b6f9-693a7895f7b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **J2 Ventures portfolio shifts:** Ten portfolio companies are actively replacing Claude for DoD contracts.
* **Lockheed expected removal:** Major contractors moving Anthropic tech out of their supply chains.
* **Anthropic revenue hit:** 80 percent comes from enterprise clients including the recent 200 million DoD deal.
* **Abundance of caution:** Firms preemptively switching despite Claude being praised as excellent product.

My name is Victor Marx, and I'm the leading Republican candidate in the race for Governor of Colorado. Our state is at a crossroads, much like our nation was in 2024, and it's created an opportunity here that **_we can't afford to miss._** **But before I get into that** , let me tell you more about me, why I'm running, and why I need your support. My life is living proof that **no hardship is too great to overcome.** By the time I was 17 years old, I had lived in 17 homes and attended 14 schools. Every statistic said my story should have ended _very _differently. **But God had other plans for my life.** Joining the United States Marine Corps became one of the most profound decisions I ever made. The Marines taught me discipline, brotherhood, and, for the first time, gave me a true sense of purpose. Through faith and service, I learned how to turn trauma into mission. I** committed my life to rescuing and restoring others from the same darkness I once walked through.** _That commitment has defined everything I've done since._ Through my ministry, **I 've led more than 150 high-risk missions into some of the most dangerous regions on earth, **delivering trauma relief, medical aid, and hope to victims of terrorism, trafficking, and violence. **Our teams have served more than 45,000 women and children, many rescued from captivity and given a second chance at life.** Those missions require calm under pressure, moral clarity, and leadership when the cost is real. Failure isn't theoretical in those environments. _Lives are on the line._ Along the way, I've been blessed to know men of deep conviction and courage; leaders who don't just talk about change but live it. One of those men was my dear friend, the late **Charlie Kirk.** I first met Charlie while speaking at a small, predominantly Latino church in Oxnard, California. I spoke before him that morning, even though he had been scheduled as the keynote. Later, he told me he had been frustrated, until he heard the message. He said it deeply impacted him. We connected afterward (helped along by my dog, Scout), stayed in touch, and over time I spoke at multiple Turning Point and Turning Point Faith events, often alongside my bride, Eileen. I still keep the first photo from that morning as a reminder that God weaves every encounter into His greater plan. **Today, I'm stepping into a new mission, ****_right here at home._** I understand hardship because I've lived it. I understand leadership because I've practiced it in war zones, on rescue missions, and while rebuilding broken communities. Crime is rising. Families are struggling. Faith and freedom are under attack. Colorado has grown colder, _and I believe it doesn't have to stay that way._ **[That’s why I’m running for Governor of Colorado, and why I need your support.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=99311148e9ff495a87c1b40c78feeba1&_e=3FJLVrNXxaSmedhNh-gHW9hEMNVr_flQDr0DRFBJ36fcM2MjzxdwoIvIe5zSZ3qbwB84E-EteLv5eYVnQLq8AfrUCz64ijbMf11BvNRDQVXeDS85ZR6gxTF6fzl-FKGIc5oUA1uqN7dvwQXQDQWsMbcedXg2iwVt3XOhmUg_A5lRayy2Z6COUo0642gcHK0uvc5BYm-JXHtPe1HsrY_oBzVRb-q85PB8SvH9RC-3fUlhwNigk26XK6IIyuwtA0dvGSZNbwUBc6OLrkVMsG6bkKGALEjC3CCOvf9BCDnAPPts8vMkHt0O-eUNhwmqKa13SNQfW-CxuYIiltZK-ADyqglYrlYnm7b2ZQy__D-QVOv6MbkRbpoW9prn30QDULz1tKQ_4q3BALwBvrKZYp3w8I7Z4WfNYOpwqeXgMSQlYCsBCMHiIVvKKt-giaa8JP5rDH5fEn39TBvSw27FJM4zJ3Veo1HKhTwOprQ41W3n-nuEXKok7Kci2SIevdW9n6X-4WrwacC2iDA7KjqlQprABpqTwuYHo0Bw5iBcR_Be9ttCkiEIds8x3K9ZPH0gJby1lQu8DYrXV5Yu9wtnkRwxyZk_zVrnCwv0pDXFfjVwGkAnRHrUptis4RCaJjYGl3MqVWILYtBsrouTY6RHcn8RqQ%3D%3D)**

This race matters because **_what happens here won't stay here._** Colorado has become a proving ground for policies that weaken public safety, punish hard work, and sideline faith and family. If that path continues unchecked, the consequences won't just be felt in Denver, **they 'll echo across the country.** _But the opposite is also true._ If Colorado chooses leadership that is disciplined, courageous, and rooted in moral conviction, it sends a message that renewal is possible. That states don't have to surrender to decline. That ordinary citizens, parents, workers, veterans, and believers can still reclaim the future of the places they love.
---
My wife Eileen and I have been married for 37 years. We've raised five children and are now proud grandparents. While some of our older children have moved away, **Colorado is my home, **and I want to ensure it remains a place where hard work is rewarded, families are supported, freedom is defended, and future generations are proud to inherit it. This campaign isn't powered by insiders or special interests. It's powered by people who believe Colorado's best days are still ahead, and who understand that leadership matters most when the stakes are high. If you're just learning about this campaign, I hope you'll consider standing with us today. **[Your contribution, whether $25, $50, or whatever you’re able to give, helps us build a disciplined, grassroots movement capable of winning this race and restoring leadership worthy of Colorado.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=99311148e9ff495a87c1b40c78feeba1&_e=3FJLVrNXxaSmedhNh-gHW9hEMNVr_flQDr0DRFBJ36fcM2MjzxdwoIvIe5zSZ3qbwB84E-EteLv5eYVnQLq8AfrUCz64ijbMf11BvNRDQVXeDS85ZR6gxTF6fzl-FKGIc5oUA1uqN7dvwQXQDQWsMbcedXg2iwVt3XOhmUg_A5lRayy2Z6COUo0642gcHK0uvc5BYm-JXHtPe1HsrY_oBzVRb-q85PB8SvH9RC-3fUliHm3_zZvP62cZAlNzUK57uCuQlnra38vhTQjQ4HrEoxjXWsSXu7iZTo11_hivRM6QBo2BmpQaMkQyFoTSXray5ex_I3dy63xNfiiLpH58hKcoCG6VHA46emC1ZKdZBAYo9uoolfgBq7TRkNgI7OeGLF6v0TLPIZAXkrkwk9ex4PxvHS45VzEplglyLYt8GMHLrKeUmGI6R740RuCNXFTmqfp2ItZbvvxfkt-mcT6YxrejPb85u02A1GxqInPE5RtYtKzb6OU_uwyGUik4R2EM4E2J9GyDpYs6hTz7F59ImyIH2WKcog3Q8NvJMj7cnRrYSNdNp4MfocZlPxwjs0mYXMMSXi6H_sk0LbsoVqtM55hgJVz834EEvJPvKyV8RcZC6S_AWB0QwqCA_N1yKz1GMmro05Tpr6qgaSxBcpk_7g%3D%3D)**

clean_body: Fed up with weak leaders I understand hardship because I've lived it. I understand leadership because I've practiced it in war zones, on rescue missions, and while rebuilding broken communities. | | | | | Friend, My name is Victor Marx, and I'm the leading Republican candidate in the race for Governor of Colorado. Our state is at a crossroads, much like our nation was in 2024, and it's created an opportunity here that we can't afford to miss. But before I get into that , let me tell you more about me, why I'm running, and why I need your support. My life is living proof that no hardship is too great to overcome. By the time I was 17 years old, I had lived in 17 homes and attended 14 schools. Every statistic said my story should have ended very differently. But God had other plans for my life. Joining the United States Marine Corps became one of the most profound decisions I ever made. The Marines taught me discipline, brotherhood, and, for the first time, gave me a true sense of purpose. Through faith and service, I learned how to turn trauma into mission. I committed my life to rescuing and restoring others from the same darkness I once walked through. That commitment has defined everything I've done since. Through my ministry, I 've led more than 150 high-risk missions into some of the most dangerous regions on earth, delivering trauma relief, medical aid, and hope to victims of terrorism, trafficking, and violence. Our teams have served more than 45,000 women and children, many rescued from captivity and given a second chance at life. Those missions require calm under pressure, moral clarity, and leadership when the cost is real. Failure isn't theoretical in those environments. Lives are on the line. Along the way, I've been blessed to know men of deep conviction and courage; leaders who don't just talk about change but live it. One of those men was my dear friend, the late Charlie Kirk. I first met Charlie while speaking at a small, predominantly Latino church in Oxnard, California. I spoke before him that morning, even though he had been scheduled as the keynote. Later, he told me he had been frustrated, until he heard the message. He said it deeply impacted him. We connected afterward (helped along by my dog, Scout), stayed in touch, and over time I spoke at multiple Turning Point and Turning Point Faith events, often alongside my bride, Eileen. I still keep the first photo from that morning as a reminder that God weaves every encounter into His greater plan. Today, I'm stepping into a new mission, right here at home. I understand hardship because I've lived it. I understand leadership because I've practiced it in war zones, on rescue missions, and while rebuilding broken communities. Crime is rising. Families are struggling. Faith and freedom are under attack. Colorado has grown colder, and I believe it doesn't have to stay that way. | | This race matters because what happens here won't stay here. Colorado has become a proving ground for policies that weaken public safety, punish hard work, and sideline faith and family. If that path continues unchecked, the consequences won't just be felt in Denver, they 'll echo across the country. But the opposite is also true. If Colorado chooses leadership that is disciplined, courageous, and rooted in moral conviction, it sends a message that renewal is possible. That states don't have to surrender to decline. That ordinary citizens, parents, workers, veterans, and believers can still reclaim the future of the places they love. My wife Eileen and I have been married for 37 years. We've raised five children and are now proud grandparents. While some of our older children have moved away, Colorado is my home, and I want to ensure it remains a place where hard work is rewarded, families are supported, freedom is defended, and future generations are proud to inherit it. This campaign isn't powered by insiders or special interests. It's powered by people who believe Colorado's best days are still ahead, and who understand that leadership matters most when the stakes are high. If you're just learning about this campaign, I hope you'll consider standing with us today. We've faced challenges before. Together, we can renew Colorado's promise. name: Laura Friedman (personal)
subject: When ‘good enough’ isn’t good enough
body:
Hi friend,
Thank you for opening this. I promise I’ll be quick.
National Republicans' actions in just the past weeks have made it clear this year's election will be extremely consequential, and we can't ignore the fact that my race -- every race in California -- could decide which party holds the House majority when it's all said and done.
It’s important to me that leaders use their positions to enact meaningful change that reflects the greater good, but all we've seen from this administration and this Republican supermajority has been undoing decades of progress for their own self-enrichment.
I hope you know that I've been working hard to defend our shared values and make meaningful progress for our CA-30 community, and I am proud of the dents we have made despite this anti-majority majority.
But I also recognize that good enough isn't why any of us came here. When it comes to affordability, safety, and meaningful opportunity, good enough isn't always good enough.
That's why emails like this happen. Since _Citizens United_ , money is unavoidable in campaigns. And that won't change with a Republican majority who’d rather protect their billionaire donors than stand up for you. Every dollar we raise means more than just resources for our re-election and supporting other winning campaigns. When you give, you send a message that we are united to force progressive change in Washington, and have the strength to fight Trump. That is why I value your support.
So, if you will, I'd sincerely appreciate anything you can give before this month's FEC deadline to help us have the tools to restore the Congress we know we deserve, one seat at a time.
Here's a good link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lf-q1-2026](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126642148/605531301/-2092947258?refcode=em-3.4.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjc3NDkxMzQtZmExNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FuGN1KjuHNLy2TQHfLc5IAYzYq1u5ymC3e2qZAEsSlg=)**
Thank you,
Laura

Laura Friedman for Congress
PO Box 27296
Los Angeles, CA 90027
United States
We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to [unsubscribe](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/C_LAPt2gvkyS7ttbOCAOdg2?unsubscribedata=qzQ6B2k1tkJI%2FMTpgn6dNJt8R88O8PbwpEmWuUy%2F2BGE5MdhtjagW%2FKUa%2BkwakNVGhEgmZFRCCkK5hCY7GOhY7lZY54%2BDZ%2BgjNSZKpycDGrMwqMBXjpzbIdCnuYq2RMoBajSjL1jg%2BH40lvK%2BEy%2FiAqahR7Eh4fV7GlsrjVBc8YYjDVLQYF4hEYLr5BnPv6giWfp0WcXEiTwmjbGLfD0OlG%2FsDG%2FkYn2%2BCOH%2B20%2FkqF7JXWxcGbMSWpVRo4N8J4bECGZQadH3LB%2BrQFXEJRF1JwmlRCL6kqBCr5DHZkgCYzwVY%2Fq3naxkpX1ug%2FiTqcPWyXeNAKVMiwpNrpM7RyaC719CLq8OJnNqolgkPeIrM4%2FS94%2FXh%2Bl6sbinyZEWMn0u3hwtEn8qPYhAXEv9uHNqoWsXxd7ATRwLgchjUsBT%2B83KmpW%2FeDBeV1%2BVKOnfpFQ).

Friend,

Thank you for your generous support of my campaign. It will take all of us to retake the majority. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you about another partner, whose endorsement I recently earned again: **Council for a Livable World**. They are the oldest political organization dedicated to reducing the risks of nuclear war, correcting years of wasteful Pentagon spending and championing a diplomacy-first foreign policy. The Council’s mission and endorsement matter deeply to me and I am honored to have them on our team!

**[The bottom line is this: Council for a Livable World’s work to elect to Congress people like me who want to get rid of nuclear weapons makes all of us safer.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126642689/605533827/-1894899207?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTNiMWU2NmMtZmMxNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=M7OdcqPxpzclff4gzlSO-2WeYhRbHm6RInhpOkbo11A=&emci=867080ab-fa17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=13b1e66c-fc17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=27336212)**

If we’re going to take back Congress, push back against Trump’s dangerous policies and step back from the brink of a new nuclear arms race, I need supporters like you and partners like the Council.

Council for a Livable World also relies on support from everyday people like you to achieve their goals. Alongside their supporters and the **[elected officials they have backed](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126642695/605533834/-182869126?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTNiMWU2NmMtZmMxNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=M7OdcqPxpzclff4gzlSO-2WeYhRbHm6RInhpOkbo11A=&emci=867080ab-fa17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=13b1e66c-fc17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=27336212)** , Council for a Livable World advocated policies and agreements that have **reduced the global nuclear arsenal from about 70,000 at the height of the Cold War to about 12,000 today.** That’s tremendous progress.

Despite the ongoing challenges around the world, we can — and must — finish the job.

I am grateful for their endorsement, but even more so for the ongoing partnership we share. Their voice, and the voices of their supporters, remind policymakers like me that the American people want a future defined not by conflict and insecurity but by stability, accountability and peace.

**[Together, we can build the future we deserve.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126642699/605533840/-1894899207?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTNiMWU2NmMtZmMxNy1mMTExLWE2OWEtMDAwZDNhMWYwYTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=M7OdcqPxpzclff4gzlSO-2WeYhRbHm6RInhpOkbo11A=&emci=867080ab-fa17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=13b1e66c-fc17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=27336212)**

Thank you,

Derek

clean_body: | = Friend, Thank you for your generous support of my campaign. It will take all of us to retake the majority. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you about another partner, whose endorsement I recently earned again: Council for a Livable World. They are the oldest political organization dedicated to reducing the risks of nuclear war, correcting years of wasteful Pentagon spending and championing a diplomacy-first foreign policy. The Council’s mission and endorsement matter deeply to me and I am honored to have them on our team! If we’re going to take back Congress, push back against Trump’s dangerous policies and step back from the brink of a new nuclear arms race, I need supporters like you and partners like the Council. Council for a Livable World also relies on support from everyday people like you to achieve their goals. Alongside their supporters and the , Council for a Livable World advocated policies and agreements that have reduced the global nuclear arsenal from about 70,000 at the height of the Cold War to about 12,000 today. That’s tremendous progress. Despite the ongoing challenges around the world, we can — and must — finish the job. I am grateful for their endorsement, but even more so for the ongoing partnership we share. Their voice, and the voices of their supporters, remind policymakers like me that the American people want a future defined not by conflict and insecurity but by stability, accountability and peace. Thank you, Derek P.S. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
ELB: Supreme Court Reverses Lower Court Order That Redrew Congressional Map in Staten Island, with Ominous Implications for Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030426_2&amount=25]
Team:The Supreme Court didn't rule on Louisiana v. Callais , but a decision from the so-called "shadow docket" holds some ominous warning signs for that case and the future of the Voting Rights Act (VRA).
The Supreme Court this week reversed a lower court order requiring the drawing of a "minority opportunity district" in New York state. The lower court had ruled that that type of district was likely required under the New York state Constitution.
" What's that kind of district ," you ask? Minority opportunity districts are electoral districts drawn during redistricting to ensure minority populations can elect candidates of their choice , often functioning as "majority-minority" districts. These districts help minorities overcome historical underrepresentation and are mandated by the Voting Rights Act to prevent the use of gerrymandering to dilute minority voting power.
Well, the opponents of voting rights on the Supreme Court didn't care about that. Conservative Justice Samuel Alito, writing for the majority in the sudden decision, said that that race conscious districting in state laws and state constitutions is “ unadorned ” and “ odious ” racial discrimination. Against white people, we assume he means.
This is most ominous for Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
Team: We're fighting every day to preserve the values of the Voting Rights Act and protect our fundamental right to vote. Will you help fuel our work with $35 or whatever you can today and help us [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030426_2&amount=35] to spread the word about these cases and the consequences of dismantling the VRA? “ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
Ari Berman at Mother Jones said it best after oral arguments: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding, with the VRA no longer able to stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.

I have to say it...

The campus climate this spring?

_It 's been downright ugly._

To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast...

But this semester is different.

**This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. **

From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- _physically attacked. _

All for saying what you and I know to be true:

That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something.

And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down.

They didn't run. They didn't hide.

They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before.

_But not without cost. _

**Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... **

In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December.

It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book.

And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting...

A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children."

Then she went even further.

She told the board: _" All members of this Board are mandatory reporters... Based on the circumstances surrounding this event, **a report was made to Child Protective Services. " **_

Yes, you read that right -- she weaponized CPS against one of our students.

Filed against a **minor. **

For organizing a pro-America Turning Point USA event with his friends.

Now, I want you to imagine being 17 years old... doing everything right... following every rule... showing up with courage and conviction...

And then hearing a stranger stand up in front of your entire community and imply that you're a danger to children.

That you need to be investigated. That you're the problem.

_**Above:** "Nancy" -- the Leftist Karen who filed a CPS report against a local Club America chapter and spoke out against them at a recent school board meeting. _
---
How would _you_ respond?

Because I'll tell you what he did...

He walked up to that microphone -- calm, steady, unshaken -- and said:

_" We have been accused of many things... I'm the president of the group. I'm 17, I'm a minor. I can't groom children because I am a child." _

Seventeen years old. Standing alone. But standing strong in front of his entire community while facing outrageous, malicious accusations.

That's courage. The kind of courage Charlie would've been proud of.

And that courage is catching fire across the country. _But so is the hatred. _

Because what happened in Maryland wasn't an isolated incident... It's just the beginning:

🚨 **At Lawrence University in Wisconsin, Leftists on campus are trying to permanently shut down a brand-new TPUSA chapter before it even starts. **

Never mind that Lawrence has over 160 student clubs... and not one is right-leaning. Or that the university handbook bans discrimination based on political affiliation.

One of our students there is now receiving death threats.

And instead of protecting him?

The Left-wing student government is putting the chapter's fate up to a campus-wide vote.

🚨 **At Iowa State University, **Colby Brandt -- the student body president -- was threatened with _**impeachment**_ because he had connections to TPUSA. Fortunately, his "impeachment" was dismissed by the student government's judicial branch... But this was only after the outrage that followed on social media and the university's administration came to its senses.

Friend, I want to thank you for your continued support of my Climate PAC. Your commitment to electing bolder and braver leaders than what we’re currently seeing in Washington means more to me than I can express. Today, I’m not reaching out to ask for a donation or to talk about strategy. I simply want to acknowledge what many of us felt over the weekend. I spent Saturday in downtown Los Angeles, standing alongside hundreds of people who, like me, are deeply alarmed by what is unfolding with Iran. I said it there and I'll say it here: **this is an unnecessary war that was waged in our names — but not with our consent. Let regime change start at home.** That’s why I’m writing to ask: how are you holding up? **[A few weeks ago, I reached out to ask what you were doing to take care of yourself. The responses I received moved me deeply. And given everything that has unfolded since, I felt it was important to check in again. If there’s something you’d like to share about how you’re taking care of yourself, or if you simply need to get something off your chest, I’m here to listen.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126644677/605540084/-1504811813?refcode=ea.4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ms=ea.4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRlODE4ZmM2LWZmMTctZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTFmMGE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wiVZxYFGNadrDLWI4gA8lUbQJvDb6Em_STbvrzHQOXM=&emci=3a818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=4823105)** | [MESSAGE JANE →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126644678/605540085/-1504811813?refcode=ea.4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ms=ea.4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRlODE4ZmM2LWZmMTctZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTFmMGE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wiVZxYFGNadrDLWI4gA8lUbQJvDb6Em_STbvrzHQOXM=&emci=3a818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=4823105)

It’s heartbreaking to see another illegal and unjust war based on false information. I can’t help but think back to the Vietnam War and the painful lessons we were supposed to learn about who truly pays the price of war.
At the time of writing this message, six American service members have already lost their lives. More than 500 civilians have been reported dead across Iran — at least 100 of whom are young girls and students. Families are grieving. And the ripple effects for people and our planet are impossible to fully know yet.
I'm 88 years old. I have lived through a lot. And one thing I’ve learned over time is that we cannot keep showing up for the things we love if we are running on empty. Being there for each other and taking care of ourselves is how we stay in this fight for the long haul.
**[If you have a few minutes, I'd really love to hear how you’re taking care of yourself right now. Every response I read reminds me that we're not alone in this, and that means everything.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126644679/605540086/-1504811813?refcode=ea.4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ms=ea.4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRlODE4ZmM2LWZmMTctZjExMS1hNjlhLTAwMGQzYTFmMGE5NyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wiVZxYFGNadrDLWI4gA8lUbQJvDb6Em_STbvrzHQOXM=&emci=3a818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=4e818fc6-ff17-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&ceid=4823105)**
