clean_body: | Friend, I want to thank you for your continued support of my Climate PAC. Your commitment to electing bolder and braver leaders than what we’re currently seeing in Washington means more to me than I can express. Today, I’m not reaching out to ask for a donation or to talk about strategy. I simply want to acknowledge what many of us felt over the weekend. I spent Saturday in downtown Los Angeles, standing alongside hundreds of people who, like me, are deeply alarmed by what is unfolding with Iran. I said it there and I'll say it here: this is an unnecessary war that was waged in our names — but not with our consent. Let regime change start at home. That’s why I’m writing to ask: how are you holding up? | It’s heartbreaking to see another illegal and unjust war based on false information. I can’t help but think back to the Vietnam War and the painful lessons we were supposed to learn about who truly pays the price of war. At the time of writing this message, six American service members have already lost their lives. More than 500 civilians have been reported dead across Iran — at least 100 of whom are young girls and students. Families are grieving. And the ripple effects for people and our planet are impossible to fully know yet. I'm 88 years old. I have lived through a lot. And one thing I’ve learned over time is that we cannot keep showing up for the things we love if we are running on empty. Being there for each other and taking care of ourselves is how we stay in this fight for the long haul. Thank you for being here. xx Jane | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/04c09d0eee68/breaking-news-citizens-only-voting-amendment-submitted-to-board-of-canvassers-8371508?e=ecf60db114)

Friends,
Today is a HUGE day.
Americans for Citizen Only Voting has officially submitted more than 750,000 petition signatures to place the Citizen Only Voting amendment on the ballot in Michigan.
Let that sink in.
More than 750,000 voices.
More than 750,000 Michiganders who stood up and said their vote matters.
More than 750,000 signatures because of YOU.
That’s almost 70% MORE than the requirement and more than 4 months ahead of the deadline for this measure to be on the November ballot.
This milestone belongs to the hundreds of volunteers who gave thousands of hours. They showed up in the heat, in the wind, in the rain, and even in frigid, below-zero temperatures. They stood outside events, knocked doors, attended festivals, and talked to neighbors in every corner of our great state.
From Detroit to the U.P., from small towns to big cities, this was, in part, a true grassroots movement powered by people who care deeply about protecting citizen-only voting.
We are also deeply grateful to those who gave financially to make our effort possible. Your support funded materials, outreach, training, and the infrastructure needed to organize across Michigan. This victory belongs to you too.
Today is a monumental achievement. A historic moment. Proof of what happens when citizens step up and lead.
There is more work ahead to ensure this amendment appears on the ballot, that voters understand the amendment and turn out to support it. But today, we celebrate how far we have come and the incredible team that made it possible.
Thank you for your time.
Thank you for your energy.
Thank you for your sacrifice.
Thank you for your generosity.
Thank you for believing this was possible.
Onward, together.
With deep gratitude and excitement,
Americans for Citizen Only Voting - Michigan
P.S. Check out our press release below.
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://michcov.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=12ae025e5876fdceb812e1ab0&id=aa4616e597&e=ecf60db114)

|
---
| |
**Americans for Citizen Voting Submits 750,000 Petition Signatures** _**Set to Place Citizen-Only Voting, Voter ID on Michigan Ballot**_******LANSING, MI** \- Americans for Citizen Voting today announced at a press conference in Lansing the submission of more than 750,000 petition signatures in support of a statewide ballot initiative to require that only American citizens vote in Michigan elections, mandate photo identification to cast a ballot, and implement a systematic review of Michigan’s Qualified Voter File. The submission far exceeds the 446,198 valid signatures required under Michigan law. The signatures, collected from every county across the state of Michigan, represent an overwhelming, bipartisan show of support for election integrity and voter confidence. From the Upper Peninsula to Southeast Michigan, voters across the political spectrum signed on to support clear, enforceable election standards. “More than seven hundred and fifty thousand Michiganders made their voices heard,” said Paul Jacob, Chair of Americans for Citizen Voting. “They support citizen-only voting, they support photo ID, and they support maintaining a clean and accurate voter file. This campaign was driven by common sense and a shared belief that our elections are the foundation of our democracy. One citizen, one vote.” Polling consistently shows strong bipartisan agreement on these principles, including more than 70 percent among Independents, more than 80 percent among Republicans, and more Democrats than not, reinforcing that the security of our elections is not a partisan issue, but a foundational expectation widely shared by Michigan voters. Former Michigan Secretary of State and current State Senator Ruth Johnson said the initiative reflects what voters have been asking for: “People want secure elections and clean voter rolls,” said Johnson (R-Holly). “They want to know that only eligible citizens are voting, that photo ID is required at the polls, and that the state is taking seriously its responsibility to maintain an accurate Qualified Voter File. This level of support shows that Michigan voters are paying attention and expect accountability.” Paid circulators and more than 17,000 volunteers gathered signatures in all 83 counties, engaging voters in cities, townships, and rural communities alike. Organizers say the geographic breadth of the petition drive underscores the depth and durability of statewide support. Organizers have thoroughly checked to verify more than enough valid signatures to place the measure on the ballot and look forward to fair and expeditious certification from the Secretary of State office. Rep. Ann Bollin commended the effort. “We saw noncitizens vote in Michigan in 2024 despite claims from Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson that this does not happen,” said Bollin (R-Brighton). “As a former clerk, I applaud this campaign to restore integrity. I sincerely thank all of the volunteers and residents who gathered and signed petitions to help secure our elections.” “Seven hundred and fifty thousand signatures speak volumes,” Jacob added. “We look forward to the certification process and to giving Michigan voters the opportunity to decide this issue at the ballot box.” Rep. Rachelle Smit, also a former clerk and chair of the House Election Integrity Committee further supported the need for the initiative. “We know the public wants photo ID for voting and for only citizens to vote,” said Smit (R-Martin Twp). “Today the people of Michigan sent a very strong message with the number of signatures that have been collected to get this on the ballot. I am confident that voters in November will deliver that same message.”

clean_body: You made this happen | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, Today is a HUGE day. Americans for Citizen Only Voting has officially submitted more than 750,000 petition signatures to place the Citizen Only Voting amendment on the ballot in Michigan. Let that sink in. More than 750,000 voices. More than 750,000 Michiganders who stood up and said their vote matters. More than 750,000 signatures because of YOU. That’s almost 70% MORE than the requirement and more than 4 months ahead of the deadline for this measure to be on the November ballot. This milestone belongs to the hundreds of volunteers who gave thousands of hours. They showed up in the heat, in the wind, in the rain, and even in frigid, below-zero temperatures. They stood outside events, knocked doors, attended festivals, and talked to neighbors in every corner of our great state. From Detroit to the U.P., from small towns to big cities, this was, in part, a true grassroots movement powered by people who care deeply about protecting citizen-only voting. We are also deeply grateful to those who gave financially to make our effort possible. Your support funded materials, outreach, training, and the infrastructure needed to organize across Michigan. This victory belongs to you too. Today is a monumental achievement. A historic moment. Proof of what happens when citizens step up and lead. There is more work ahead to ensure this amendment appears on the ballot, that voters understand the amendment and turn out to support it. But today, we celebrate how far we have come and the incredible team that made it possible. Thank you for your time. Thank you for your energy. Thank you for your sacrifice. Thank you for your generosity. Thank you for believing this was possible. Onward, together. With deep gratitude and excitement, Americans for Citizen Only Voting - Michigan P.S. Check out our press release below. | | | | Americans for Citizen Voting Submits 750,000 Petition Signatures Set to Place Citizen-Only Voting, Voter ID on Michigan Ballot****LANSING, MI \- Americans for Citizen Voting today announced at a press conference in Lansing the submission of more than 750,000 petition signatures in support of a statewide ballot initiative to require that only American citizens vote in Michigan elections, mandate photo identification to cast a ballot, and implement a systematic review of Michigan’s Qualified Voter File. The submission far exceeds the 446,198 valid signatures required under Michigan law. The signatures, collected from every county across the state of Michigan, represent an overwhelming, bipartisan show of support for election integrity and voter confidence. From the Upper Peninsula to Southeast Michigan, voters across the political spectrum signed on to support clear, enforceable election standards. “More than seven hundred and fifty thousand Michiganders made their voices heard,” said Paul Jacob, Chair of Americans for Citizen Voting. “They support citizen-only voting, they support photo ID, and they support maintaining a clean and accurate voter file. This campaign was driven by common sense and a shared belief that our elections are the foundation of our democracy. One citizen, one vote.” Polling consistently shows strong bipartisan agreement on these principles, including more than 70 percent among Independents, more than 80 percent among Republicans, and more Democrats than not, reinforcing that the security of our elections is not a partisan issue, but a foundational expectation widely shared by Michigan voters. Former Michigan Secretary of State and current State Senator Ruth Johnson said the initiative reflects what voters have been asking for: “People want secure elections and clean voter rolls,” said Johnson (R-Holly). “They want to know that only eligible citizens are voting, that photo ID is required at the polls, and that the state is taking seriously its responsibility to maintain an accurate Qualified Voter File. This level of support shows that Michigan voters are paying attention and expect accountability.” Paid circulators and more than 17,000 volunteers gathered signatures in all 83 counties, engaging voters in cities, townships, and rural communities alike. Organizers say the geographic breadth of the petition drive underscores the depth and durability of statewide support. Organizers have thoroughly checked to verify more than enough valid signatures to place the measure on the ballot and look forward to fair and expeditious certification from the Secretary of State office. Rep. Ann Bollin commended the effort. “We saw noncitizens vote in Michigan in 2024 despite claims from Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson that this does not happen,” said Bollin (R-Brighton). “As a former clerk, I applaud this campaign to restore integrity. I sincerely thank all of the volunteers and residents who gathered and signed petitions to help secure our elections.” “Seven hundred and fifty thousand signatures speak volumes,” Jacob added. “We look forward to the certification process and to giving Michigan voters the opportunity to decide this issue at the ballot box.” Rep. Rachelle Smit, also a former clerk and chair of the House Election Integrity Committee further supported the need for the initiative. “We know the public wants photo ID for voting and for only citizens to vote,” said Smit (R-Martin Twp). “Today the people of Michigan sent a very strong message with the number of signatures that have been collected to get this on the ballot. I am confident that voters in November will deliver that same message.” | | | We are going to need our entire grassroots nation to get out and support this effort. Go to our website to sign up for updates, like and follow us on social media and help us spread the word. This issue will be critical to 2026 and we need you! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Americans for Citizen Voting Michigan. All rights reserved.

Lent is not just a season.It is a pilgrimage.A journey led by the Holy Spirit... into the desert.**And the desert is not empty.**
**It is sacred.**
**It is where God reminds us who we are.** When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested.

But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: **_" You are my beloved Son."_**That same Father speaks over you.**You are His beloved son.**
**His beloved daughter.** Before any label.
Before any denomination.And so is every child.Even the child who has been lured... kidnapped... sold.
---
You may not know me yet.My name is Eduardo Verastegui.I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking.**What I heard broke my heart.** Children treated like products.
Like profit.
Like they do not matter.I asked myself,_" What if it were my child?"_That question changed my life. The film became a movement.
And the **Sound of Freedom Foundation was born.** But the story did not end when the credits rolled. Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins.We **equip **trusted partners who rescue children.
We **educate **families so they can protect their sons and daughters.
We **advocate** for laws that defend the innocent.This is not politics.
It is protection.
**It is faith in action.**
---

But if we are honest...Our hearts can grow numb and we get distracted. We get comfortable.**Lent is a wake-up call.** A time for metanoia.
A turning back to God.This Lenten season, pause and ask the Holy Spirit: "What do **You** want to restore in me?"Your prayer life?
Your courage?
Your tenderness toward the vulnerable?Because when hearts grow cold...children suffer.And today, many of God's children are enslaved.**They are created in His image.**
**They belong to Him.**
**Their dignity is sacred.** When we forget that... the innocent pay the price.

| Hi folks,

Late last week, Donald Trump launched America into another regime change war in the Middle East.

If you feel like you’ve seen this script before, it’s because you have. It’s a tired one: The U.S.bombs a country, and then asks for the people of that country to rise up. This is the same playbook from Iraq, Libya, and Syria. **In those three countries alone, millions of people died – not just from the bombs, but from what happens after.**

Khamenei was a horrible person who was responsible for decades of brutal repression, including the execution of thousands of political prisoners and the violent suppression of pro-democracy protests.

But the cost of what comes next may be just as devastating. Because when you destroy a country's infrastructure — its power grid, its water treatment systems, its hospitals — people die from a million different causes that never make the news. And that's what's about to happen in Iran.

The power vacuum will be filled by competing factions, civil war, and chaos. This is not going to end in just a few weeks.

Permanent damage has been done, but Congress still has power to save lives and do _some_ damage control.

**_[That’s why I’m asking you to tell your member of Congress: pass the War Powers Resolution and stop this needless war!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_5hbu1DV_K1a9EsXVVRCLGpB39QV8SsNTiQz3v_gpY97SZCaMQ1plN36C8Ur4lF6LCOR1cY5Fsn7Cg7aqHsbWvh0fxDmITyU2Q6diL9gTWdIjLqygvZ5pVqOhB1ioU78dWGisodJCZrZ0YwFK6wdqOY2ciX2vLhQyqOBWVPaIM3gL5yjf5zoCISxBYHSClLEc51PQgHCjAAHa0YBtQKyKdvifM76c1f7TRds0ygdwaPLTqg0TcCv8jlS1wFZI0SC3VsfI7QJFZEJjwwDGOS3bQxWo15nWwkNqP66yFblARvVaoAzXJmQLrIZJQyQIXIBQc2o60CEVy-R3hrOzbDVOQdkav0SVT5qSKuu4wgT3v8Q/4on/Yv2iA7JcS_a7srZE7sOj6Q/h0/h001.rBrgi7uFgV_4JqJb9e7tiQOIhW12oEnlYsiIgfxjw6k)_** [Tell Congress: No war with Iran »](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_5hbu1DV_K1a9EsXVVRCLGpB39QV8SsNTiQz3v_gpY97SZCaMQ1plN36C8Ur4lF6LCOR1cY5Fsn7Cg7aqHsbWvh0fxDmITyU2Q6diL9gTWdIjLqygvZ5pVqOhB1ioU78deDO-FiXccqO_cnJk8xUCC1YjkqWKWiC-6F-UC2CleT1hQocOqBWRp0KykniWh34mmBgzVkMWy-DO_-Hj6QtEBRwQKCUva7f8wcMZIzLiiV04t-hByDKM7hN1E4yc-67ZU7EFUikWQ8TDs9IZazqpCyaIgoubYJnKDqRGMw80tUM63lE-GXf8UxigJOFptB4G-ekC8Vajf9vzGpANQENrW926BuRKh1oiZD4dNcTa2Qw/4on/Yv2iA7JcS_a7srZE7sOj6Q/h1/h001.3779RYJYyjt645xOsNAtYiz7c_WR2NdhSwvf1zP6Mco) What makes me sick is that for Trump, this is just good TV. He gets to play president. He gets to engage his base.

**The truth is, Donald Trump attacked Iran because he’s failed to turn our country’s economy around and he’s terrified that people will uncover why he’s mentioned so many times in the Epstein files.**

We needed a vote on Rep. Ro Khanna and Tom Massie’s War Powers Resolution last week. Instead, the war hawks in Congress delayed it.

**I believe any politician who is not doing everything they can to stop this war should lose their seat in 2026._[If you agree, take a moment, right now, to tell Congress to pass the War Powers Resolution and stop this needless war »](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_5hbu1DV_K1a9EsXVVRCLGpB39QV8SsNTiQz3v_gpY97SZCaMQ1plN36C8Ur4lF6LCOR1cY5Fsn7Cg7aqHsbWvh0fxDmITyU2Q6diL9gTWdIjLqygvZ5pVqOhB1ioU78ciTnLHWrrPWzcagBniG1LFPYIc07ohVSWXof1F9COsKYe31kLd-FkxK63Ceo4jIVg4u_uKXPnNZZwpQFCATl_Asr86RCvW-c0YIazOsKwyCSxOWKhCC2p74sWRNuMHcief4QvNQBWQXYQkImy5EOeysqFAL7vN4U7h3tWyv83HJeHxgxDbBINWVS0DWNTT-RVyyP42FaHnyF7_YDfgdLF9Y3sNiKw_R-FR2Jwb96UdYQ/4on/Yv2iA7JcS_a7srZE7sOj6Q/h2/h001.V54NKBt-SF-PNXq7ZQ1pab242c8mkcA50y-lWvQ7csQ)_** [Sign now »](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_5hbu1DV_K1a9EsXVVRCLGpB39QV8SsNTiQz3v_gpY97SZCaMQ1plN36C8Ur4lF6LCOR1cY5Fsn7Cg7aqHsbWvh0fxDmITyU2Q6diL9gTWdIjLqygvZ5pVqOhB1ioU78cdLXOfIDyMFFywSEHd5Ph3PSJW8pqPQh9MB92lgK8sqLm6rlX9wtnclVqDdw55fuKArFCdqKVZDPdjezb55Obr_9NMKp-oGeOTS-WtllUJAhmMNFFrmfifPzzYXTVYVt1trW0TOnTH9mwllTzYrDhWJRPueCkh0kxp1n7SMwP3IU66U_Cf7vrTC7Kyekp5GaTc6NQuJU22bHjfezFKY21c67uQQxrfTHUIiGECnwmToQ/4on/Yv2iA7JcS_a7srZE7sOj6Q/h3/h001.n_qldBH2Ti3XjFtgGUyj2tclirz7cqTrfxrEYcBJiX8) Early reports out of Iran show mass civilian casualties – including an estimated more than 180 dead after strikes on schools. We’ve also seen 6 American servicemembers killed and that number will only rise.

**Let me be clear: I oppose wars of aggression, and if elected, I will do everything in my power to reign in the lawless Trump regime.**

Right now, my thoughts are with the Iranian people, American troops in harm’s way, and everyone whose safety is jeopardized by Trump’s reckless aggression.

I don’t know how this will end, but I’m certain it’s going to take a network of grassroots resistance to demand better from our government.

-Saikat

Permanent damage has been done, but Congress still has power to save lives and do some damage control. What makes me sick is that for Trump, this is just good TV. He gets to play president. He gets to engage his base. The truth is, Donald Trump attacked Iran because he’s failed to turn our country’s economy around and he’s terrified that people will uncover why he’s mentioned so many times in the Epstein files. We needed a vote on Rep. Ro Khanna and Tom Massie’s War Powers Resolution last week. Instead, the war hawks in Congress delayed it. I believe any politician who is not doing everything they can to stop this war should lose their seat in 2026. Early reports out of Iran show mass civilian casualties – including an estimated more than 180 dead after strikes on schools. We’ve also seen 6 American servicemembers killed and that number will only rise. Let me be clear: I oppose wars of aggression, and if elected, I will do everything in my power to reign in the lawless Trump regime. Right now, my thoughts are with the Iranian people, American troops in harm’s way, and everyone whose safety is jeopardized by Trump’s reckless aggression. I don’t know how this will end, but I’m certain it’s going to take a network of grassroots resistance to demand better from our government. -Saikat | | | | Saikat Chakrabarti was Bernie’s Tech Director, AOC’s first chief of staff, founded Justice Democrats, and helped bring the Green New Deal to life. Peter,

February was busy in the best possible way. You know that feeling when you get on a roll, and you can almost touch the momentum with every step forward? That's exactly what last month felt like.

Day after day, I had the chance to talk with more Iowans, hear their stories, and share my vision for our district. Along the way, we reached some incredible milestones together. We officially filed to get on the ballot, our race was named a Red to Blue priority by the DCCC, and — thanks to this team — we hit our end-of-month fundraising goal, even on the shortest month of the year. I'm so grateful to everyone who helped make that possible.

And I don't know about you, but I'm still feeling the energy, and I'm taking it right into March. March is a big month because at the end, we'll be facing our first end-of-quarter deadline of the election year. A few days after that, the FEC will publish our campaign numbers for everyone to see, including Mariannette Miller-Meeks and her corporate backers. We have a great chance to show just how strong our movement is.

I've always believed this race will be decided by conversations in living rooms, at kitchen tables, and in communities across the district, not in boardrooms or closed-door meetings. **[I know we can win in November, but it will take all of us continuing to show up and build on the momentum we've created together. body:
This is not just about the threats we face, but the power we have as citizens.
---

Peter, we need to be honest with ourselves in this moment.
It's important to understand the full implications of what this administration is trying to do and the threat it poses to the basic freedoms of every American. We're witnessing a deliberate attempt to erode values and norms that have made our country free and prosperous.
**But it’s not enough to simply recognize the threats we face. We also have to be clear about the power we have in a moment like this. **
The most important title in America isn’t president or senator or governor — it’s citizen. In this country, we the people have the power to determine the path forward.
Right now, some politicians have it twisted. They think they have the right to pick who their voters are so they can unfairly lock in their power in the next election.
They’re wrong. And it’s up to us to fight back against these attacks on our democracy.
**Peter, that’s why we need you in this fight.** We can't just wring our hands. We can't let cynicism get the best of us. It's our job, as Americans, to go out and do something about it. To speak out. To vote. To organize our neighbors and to understand that our best hope of solving this problem is by working together.
You know that I’ve always believed in that creed written in our founding documents and carried forward through generations: "Yes we can." And in a year like this, it takes on an even greater meaning.
When Attorney General Holder and I started Redistricting Action, we did so because we knew there would come a time when our democracy needed a grassroots movement to fight for it. [**This is that moment. And we need you with us. Please read every word of this email. Democrats need to flip four Senate seats to take back the majority in 2026. And I'm increasingly convinced that Texas is one of them. Last night, James Talarico won Texas’ Democratic Primary – and he’s entering the general election in a dead heat. James is a former middle school teacher, seminarian, and eighth-generation Texan who flipped a Trump district in his very first race for the Texas State House. And here’s the good news: he’s already statistically tied against either Republican opponent before a single general election dollar has been spent. = | | = James knows what it takes to build a coalition that criss-crosses background and party lines. His desire to reach every voter, not just Democrats, is part of the reason why he won. That’s exactly the kind of candidate who can flip Texas blue. And winning in Texas would give us a clear shot at retaking the Senate. On the other side? Republicans are already tearing each other apart. Ken Paxton, who was impeached by a bipartisan majority in the Texas State House, is locked in a brutal runoff against Sen. John Cornyn. Cornyn and his super PAC allies burned through at least $69 million and barely limped into the runoff. His own party has pledged to make Paxton “unelectable.” Whoever survives the GOP’s runoff effort will be damaged and defined by months of attacks from within their own party. James will be ready. The Supreme Court handed parents a landmark 6-3 victory Monday night, blocking California's secretive [gender transition policy](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHOnDAQhJ_GdD6ZxT9wBUUaukubEi323t1KeI28PkjePiJlyr8baUajT9-vx_JA3lhePzHRFA5eYo5LQq1UEkvMz1o-aUdVVGVZwEFvXWedX2Rb2iZOIfYdNDS1wwD919iNrnlPoVv7NoYQvu6rR2qD9z0ixDHeYaUnNTxdT65zHlrXt-OtHe4wDrSOfm3HYe2Nd589YiW9hSxK5cDKB7FIvlKWW8ip2aZ3rbua7oeB2cB8nuftRH2zvGoW-o2Jhco1NTALnWpg1s9eKJEN-VOqgdn7YXQA_zf2jRLVBtz4mYsw2h0LSVV7sth8ULFKoVC1L5JIxdaConyh2T1vHP4YmJsyxf3kbWPtB-PdKyFv_8jrN2QfE_wNAAD__2Wmk84) that forced schools to hide students' transgender status from their own mothers and fathers. Justice Kagan dissented, calling the emergency docket a "malfunction." body:
Grassroots-backed election amendments fall short as House advances HB26-1113
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers rejected grassroots-backed amendments to HB26-1113 that would have [tightened ballot circulation rules and preserved citizen challenges to voter registrations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) before advancing the broader elections bill. Meanwhile, rural lawmakers from both parties [blocked a Polis-backed proposal to restrict neonicotinoid-treated crop seeds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), arguing it would impose costly regulations on farmers.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A former director of the state’s judicial discipline system filed a federal lawsuit accusing the Colorado Supreme Court and other officials of[ suppressing oversight and retaliating](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after he raised concerns about misconduct. A federal audit also found the state[ improperly paid $77.8 million for Medicaid autism therapy service](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)s, forcing Colorado to repay more than $42 million. Commentary is raising concerns that [the state is following California-style fiscal policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while [precinct caucuses across Colorado have kicked off](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) the 2026 election cycle.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Debate intensified after U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran, with [Colorado’s congressional delegation split along party lines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over the action. Reports also show Chinese state-linked propaganda networks [amplifying anti-war protests in the U.S.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) following the strikes. And in cultural commentary, one writer argues that revealing [conservative beliefs has increasingly become a “friendship test”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in a politically divided America.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, March 4, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Grassroots-backed election amendments fall short as House advances HB26-1113](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Colorado lawmakers approved a sweeping update to the state’s election laws Tuesday after rejecting several amendments that would have added voter roll verification requirements and expanded cybersecurity standards for election infrastructure.
The vote followed a second-reading debate on HB26-1113 the previous legislative day that centered on election security proposals and questions about the accuracy of Colorado’s voter rolls.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Former Judicial Discipline Director Files Federal Lawsuit Challenging Colorado Supreme Court Oversight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Whistleblower lawsuit targets judicial oversight:** Former discipline director Christopher S.P. Gregory filed a federal lawsuit accusing the Colorado Supreme Court and other officials of protecting insiders and suppressing oversight after he raised misconduct concerns.
* **Allegations tied to internal contract scandal:** Gregory’s complaint centers on the controversial “Masias contract” and claims key information was concealed from auditors and judicial oversight bodies during a wider fraud investigation inside the state court system.
* **Seeking federal intervention and reforms:** The lawsuit asks a federal judge to invalidate oversight rule changes, rebuild the judicial discipline process, and reinstate Gregory—arguing Colorado’s current system cannot effectively police itself.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Federal Audit Finds Colorado Misspent $78 Million On Autism Therapy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **$78M in improper Medicaid payments:** Federal auditors found Colorado’s Medicaid program made at least $77.8 million in improper payments for autism therapy services, forcing the state to repay $42.6 million to the federal government.
* **Questionable billing and oversight failures:** Investigators identified billing for services provided by uncredentialed behavioral technicians and other compliance issues in applied behavioral analysis therapy programs.
* **Budget pressure grows:** The findings come as Colorado faces a $1 billion budget shortfall, raising fresh concerns about oversight and accountability in state Medicaid spending.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Why we started Mesa County Compass](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RUTH KINNETT & LISA FRY | COMMENTARY | MARCH 2** _In June 2023, we were sitting at a kitchen table watching headlines move faster than facts. A recall effort was underway against District 51 School Board member Andrea Haitz, and something didn’t sit right. We kept hearing fragments — social media posts, clipped quotes, secondhand outrage — but we couldn’t find the full conversation._
**[The Rorschach republic: The MLK test for a divided nation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY MELANIE STURM | COMMENTARY | MARCH 2** _We are living through a Rorschach moment. We look at the same ink blots — the border, Epstein, gender medicine — and swear we’re seeing opposite realities. I was reminded of that recently when I found myself seated next to a gentleman at a luncheon._
**[Why I’m Running for United States Senate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SEAN POND | COMMENTARY | MARCH 2** _Colorado is being managed into decline. Not in one dramatic collapse. Not in one headline. In slow motion. Costs go up. Public safety goes down. Energy gets strangled. Rural communities get ignored. And government keeps getting bigger. I am running for United States Senate because I am tired of watching it happen._ __

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).

I know that sounds boring and nerdy, but the promise of our democracy, freedoms, and the rule of law fascinates me – and for years I thought Republicans upheld those same ideals.
I was so wrong. When I finally got a peek under the hood and saw what these lying, sleazebag, horrible MAGA loyalists were doing to our country, I couldn’t stomach it.
Let me be straight with you: Republicans are failing America, and as someone who’s been fighting Trump for years, I know exactly how to stop them.
It requires not running the same plays, election after election, hoping we’ll see different results. It means being bold and not afraid to fight fire with fire – like I’ve been doing at the cost of my career and reputation.
Look, Democrats’ success last November proved there’s hope. Trump may think he’s a king on a throne, but his wannabe dictatorship is built on a house of cards, and we are this close to toppling it.

name: Tim Walz
subject: A personal note from me following my testimony before Congress
disclaimer_text: paid for by Walz for Governor
body:
In these extraordinarily trying times, the people of Minnesota have come together to show the world our values.
#
Hi Peter — it’s Tim Walz.
Earlier today, I testified before Congress. I’m reaching out to you, as one of my strongest supporters, because you deserve to know what I said:
**I’m proud and honored to be Minnesota’s governor.** In these extraordinarily trying times, the people of Minnesota have come together to show the world our values.
But because of that, the people of Minnesota have been singled out and targeted by this Administration and its allies for political retribution at an unparalleled scale. _Including blocking Medicaid reimbursements for our state just last week._
Under the guise of combatting fraud, the federal government has flooded Minnesota with masked, untrained, and unaccountable agents who are wreaking havoc in our communities.
On the streets of Minnesota, federal agents have detained U.S. citizens who have committed no crimes. They have violated the constitutional rights of our citizens. They have ignored court orders. They have shot first and asked questions later. **Time and again, they have gaslit us by demanding that we ignore what we can see before our own eyes.**
But the American people are not that easily fooled. The images of this brutal campaign are seared into our collective memory. And long after the federal government’s agents of chaos pack up and leave, and long after the fraudsters in whose name this hearing was supposedly called are prosecuted and imprisoned, the good people of Minnesota will still be picking up the pieces from these senseless acts of cruelty and violence.
As we forge ahead, I hope Minnesotans will remain grounded in a sense of justice. A sense of right and wrong. We know that the way to deter crime is to pursue offenders regardless of who they are, not to pardon them because of who they know. We understand that a key to keeping our people safe is to allow prosecutors to uphold the law, not to punish them for refusing to violate it. And, we appreciate that public trust comes from building commonsense anti-fraud safeguards into our programs, not by tearing down established norms.
A single taxpayer dollar wasted on fraud is a dollar too much to tolerate. That is why as Governor, I have already taken decisive action.
There is undoubtedly more to do. We will continue to do the important work of combatting fraud. But as we do so, we will remain true to our principles. We will feed hungry children, help the poor afford healthcare, and assist people with disabilities, while also keeping fraud in check. **We will demonstrate our decency and integrity, and never yield to political scapegoating, particularly of our most vulnerable communities.**
I’m damn proud of the people of Minnesota. I’m proud the world has witnessed our values of neighborliness, care, and resilience. And I am honored to serve as governor.
Gratefully yours,
Tim

Thank you for standing alongside Tim Walz, Peter.
Fighting back against this kind of retaliation is expensive by design. So if you have Tim’s back as Trump and Republicans target him for upholding our values, today is an important day to show it.

Friend, Let’s stop pretending this is normal. There was a time when people said ICE just needed reform. After what I’ve seen, I don’t buy it anymore. I’ve walked through these facilities. I’ve heard directly from people held for days in conditions that no one would defend publicly. I’ve watched an agency operate like it assumes the rules don’t apply to it, just because our corrupt President and his cronies are willing to look the other way. You can’t enforce the law if you think you’re above it. What’s happening right now isn’t about safety. It’s about power. It’s about sending a message to immigrant communities — and to blue cities — that the federal government can show up, tear families apart, and trample on our fundamental rights. I won’t stand for it. **We are past reform. ICE should be abolished.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126651499/605561907/2090747700?refcode=260304_sm_ICE_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MWFkZDA1YS0xMjE4LWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QJsCOugm_s3O2qx7j2Gn-F_kmMrfFFunHnVdV8VjT_w=) And when federal agents break the law, they should be prosecuted. | | | | | | Fellow Texan,
Thank you for supporting our campaign.
Robin and I believe strongly that the Lord has a plan for our lives, and this moment is no different. We trust fully in His guidance and are grateful for the opportunities He has given us to serve.
While last night’s results were not what we hoped for, I am grateful for the record we built and the campaign we ran.
Over the past several months, we crisscrossed the state and met thousands of voters, sharing a record of delivering real results for Texas like ending DEI, safeguarding tax dollars, and launching education freedom. Republicans across Texas are energized, and it was an honor to take that message directly to voters in communities across our great state.
This campaign would not have been possible without your support. I am deeply thankful for the encouragement, prayers, and commitment from so many Texans along the way.
I want to thank Governor Greg Abbott for asking me to serve as Acting Texas Comptroller and for endorsing our campaign. I’m also grateful for the many business, law enforcement, and agricultural organizations that stood with us, as well as the hundreds of thousands of grassroots voters and supporters who believed in our mission.
I congratulate the Republican nominee, Don Huffines, and wish him success in the general election. It is critical that we unite as Republicans and ensure Texas remains the strongest, most prosperous, and most conservative state in America.
It has been an honor to serve as your Acting Texas Comptroller, and I’m excited to continue serving Texas in this role for the remainder of my term. I remain committed to keeping Texas the best place to live, work, and raise a family.
God bless Texas,
Kelly HancockActing Texas Comptroller

More freedom.** [_**I’ll dive into the details in a moment — but before I go any further, I need to ask: Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can afford to help us get that message out to every corner of Pennsylvania? **More jobs.**
Well, Derek, this one’s pretty self-explanatory. Over the last three years, we’ve created over 22,400 jobs across the Commonwealth and built the only economy in the Northeast that’s actually growing. _But I know we can do even more._
**More opportunity.**
I’ve heard it from families all across Pennsylvania: Folks just want a real shot to get ahead and build a better life. That’s why we’ve cut the college degree requirement for 92% of state jobs, directed education funding to the schools that need it most, and put more money back into Pennsylvanians’ pockets.
**More freedom.**
It’s not complicated, Derek: No matter what you look like, where you come from, who you love, who you pray to, or choose not to pray to, you deserve a government that has your back. A government that protects your most fundamental freedoms — not one that picks and chooses based on the political whims of a President.
**Jobs. Opportunity. Freedom. That’s what this campaign is all about. But I’m not naive. I know the far-right will spend whatever it takes to lie, smear, and mislead their way to victory. To twist my words and turn this campaign into something that it’s not. So I’m humbly asking:**
[_**Will you make a donation of any amount to make sure these far-right lies don’t spread unchecked? body:
Republicans know exactly what they're doing. Peter,

As a former prosecutor, I've led these kinds of depositions before, and I know what a serious investigation looks like. What we're seeing right now in the Epstein investigation is straight up political theater.

And that's not just frustrating — it's dangerous and borderline evil. Did Republicans forget that there are real victims and survivors, or do they just not care? Epstein's survivors deserve justice, which means a full, transparent investigation that follows the evidence, **_wherever it goes._**

Instead, what we're getting is selective outrage.

If you want to depose the Clintons? _Fine._

If you want to hear from President Trump? _Fine._

The first lady? Elon Musk? Anyone with relevant information? _Fine._

**Republican or Democrat, I really don't care what letter is in front of your name.**

You don't get to subpoena _just_ Democrats for headlines and then suddenly lose interest when it comes to Republicans. You don't get to close the doors to the public, deny transparency, and then leak photos for clicks.

That's not oversight, that's a show. And survivors deserve better than a show. There are still missing Epstein files and unanswered questions. Hey folks,
I jumped on with **Don Lemon** and we covered _a lot_ of ground. Texas politics, voter suppression, the MAGA civil war, and the escalating conflict with Iran. At moments it got blunt, a little dark, and honestly pretty real about where this country is headed right now. If you're trying to make sense of the chaos -- this one is worth your time.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* **00:01:07** The Texas voting chaos -- what's actually happening with polling locations and why Republicans keep building systems that make it harder for people to vote.
* **00:04:04** Trump's Iran strikes are wildly unpopular -- and the approval numbers suggest MAGA might be hitting a political ceiling.
* **00:07:05** The administration keeps contradicting itself about whether this is a war -- and Trump's own comments keep embarrassing his allies.
* **00:11:47** The staggering cost of Middle East conflict -- tens of billions already spent, with Americans footing the bill.
* **00:17:21** The bigger problem: Trump has no governing strategy. No plan for the Middle East, no plan for getting out, and no vision beyond chaos.

We also talked about the fractures inside the Republican Party, why some MAGA candidates are suddenly losing primaries, and what all of it might mean for the 2026 Senate map. The truth is, the political ground in this country is shifting fast -- and nobody really knows yet what replaces the mess we're living through now.

Investigative journalist Peter Schweizer joined me for an interview about his latest bombshell book: _[The Invisible Coup: How American Elites and Foreign Powers Use Immigration as a Weapon](https://substack.com/redirect/d97cdbaf-8c17-4490-be05-9bd418800c8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. What he revealed should alarm every American who cares about national security, the integrity of our democratic system, and the malevolent schemes Chinese communists have spent decades implementing against the United States.
Schweizer isn't just talking about the traditional immigration debate -- jobs, wages, border security, illegal alien drunk drivers mowing down pedestrians. He's exposing how foreign adversaries, particularly the Chinese Communist Party, have turned immigration into a strategic weapon against the United States.
The most shocking revelation from Schweizer's book is that over the last 13 years, approximately 100,000 babies per year have been born in the United States to Chinese nationals who immediately return to China with their newborn American citizens. That's more than 1.3 million Chinese nationals. These are not "Anchor Babies" or "Dreamers." These are Chinese citizens raised entirely under the CCP system who've exploited birthright citizenship rules to maintain U.S. citizen status. They will be eligible to vote, donate to political campaigns, and take government jobs when they turn 18.
Join 27k other patriots to subscribe to New England's best anti-communist Substack!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..a-N9MJJjUWjlNpkEGLEkBx5LQHZaDMKuO4ubXI3SWCA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=189808597)
What's worse, our federal government doesn't even track these numbers. As far as I know, Schweizer is the first investigative reporter to even attempt to assess the scale of this national security nightmare.
"China has looked at this on an industrial scale," Schweizer told me. "Research firms there have studied it. The CCP has actively encouraged their elite -- military officers, intelligence officers, propaganda officials -- to exploit our birthright citizenship laws."
The People's Daily, the CCP's main publication, has run articles telling the Chinese elite they have a "constitutional right" to obtain U.S. citizenship for their children. This isn't about Chinese dissidents seeking freedom -- these are regime loyalists executing a long-term strategic plan.
What should keep every American up at night is the question of what the CCP plans to do with the sleeping dragon that is the Chinese-in-America voting block.
*_cough_ * Gavin Newsom *_cough_ * ...
This hits close to home for Maine readers. Eight to ten years ago, newspapers including [Maine Public](https://substack.com/redirect/27a650e5-78c1-4df6-8347-50a494cea4dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the Lewiston Sun Journal hailed a proposed investment from a company called Miracle Enterprises. Chinese investors promised to transform a distressed mill property into a "medical tourism" destination where wealthy Chinese would come for hip replacements and heart surgery.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/329c0937-07fa-41ce-81ea-9151b054b053?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
City leaders celebrated the economic opportunity. Here's how Maine's [taxpayer-funded](https://substack.com/redirect/27a650e5-78c1-4df6-8347-50a494cea4dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) outlet covered it:
> The plan was announced Friday morning at a press conference in which a Chinese investment company, Central Maine Medical Center and city and state officials heralded what they call a unique opportunity.
> So, just what is a five-star medical tourism facility? In Auburn, it will be a 200-room recovery center that can house at least 5,000 guests a year.
> The investor behind the project is Miracle Enterprise, a group that has a number of health care initiatives in China, according to management representative Michelle Xu. She says their target clients are wealthy Chinese individuals who, upon their arrival at the future 5-star facility, will get a complete work-up on their health.
> "So that would include physical examination, stem cell analysis and genetic analysis and testings, and after all of that is done we'll be able to analyze the health condition of that person and what kind of treatments he or she needs," she says.
> Guests could opt for elective treatments such as anti-aging. Or they could arrive with known medical conditions, and Central Maine Medical Center is a willing partner to provide care, says President Peter Chalke.
But looking at Schweizer's research, the picture becomes clear: this was never about medical tourism. It was about birth tourism. That is, establishing facilities where CCP-sponsored officials could give birth to American citizens who, 18 years later, could help advance China's strategic objectives.
If industrial-scale birth tourism wasn't alarming enough, Schweizer uncovered an even more disturbing aspect of the industrial-scale subversion of our birthright citizenship rules vis-a-vis surrogacy.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..KLpDMLjJ1Hc3TQ8nY6_n2TcLO3OxcH_H90WaWnDkzSQ?)
Members of the Chinese elite contract with American women, paying them $50,000-$60,000 to carry their biological children to term, Schweizer reported. When the child is born, they gain U.S. citizenship -- with the added benefit of having an American biological mother. The child is then immediately taken to China to be raised in the CCP system.
The Wall Street Journal recently reported on a single Chinese billionaire close to the CCP who has _**more than 100 children**_ born this way. Schweizer's team found 107 Chinese-owned surrogacy companies operating in Southern California alone.
Why isn't anyone stopping this? Because for some, mass migration has become a political strategy.
Schweizer points out that the Democratic Party discovered in the 1990s that 85% of newly minted citizens vote Democrat. The Clinton, Obama, and Biden administrations all loosened citizenship requirements, watered down English proficiency tests, and ignored criminal background checks by the hundreds of thousands. They created the euphemism "asylum seeker" and then handed out work authorization documents that could be treated like they were Social Security numbers.
The biggest years for new U.S. citizens according to Schweizer's analysis? 1996, 2012, and 2024 -- all re-election years for Democratic presidents.
But even non-voting illegal immigrants shift political power. The U.S. Census counts people, not citizens. California currently has an estimated four to seven more congressional seats than it would if only citizens were counted. That's more political power, more Electoral College votes, and more federal funding. All of those benefits come because they're counting illegal immigrants.
As Schweizer put it: "Those four congressional seats represent a bigger delegation than 13 other states have. That's twice as many congressional votes as Maine has in the House of Representatives."
This isn't theoretical.
Here in Maine, readers of _[The Robinson Report](https://substack.com/redirect/45299382-365d-4667-90f3-af524ee8f332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ know that Secretary of State Shenna Bellows -- now running for governor -- admitted on a podcast with Marc Elias that _**there are non-citizens registered to vote in Maine**_. She later denied saying it, but the recording exists. So who are you going to believe, Shenna or your lying eyes?
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2246936&post_id=189808597&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg5ODA4NTk3LCJpYXQiOjE3NzI2NjM2MjQsImV4cCI6MTc3NTI1NTYyNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTIyNDY5MzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.xyef-Yq3CbAru3-C7jrij1PspFqhN-fRGN0AnE0AatE)
Meanwhile, Bellows is refusing to turn over Maine's voter registration file to the Department of Justice and issuing Real IDs to non-citizens who present only work authorization documents, i.e. paroled illegal aliens.
So what can be done in the face of external adversaries like the Chinese Communist Party and internal adversaries who aid and abet unlimited migration for political benefits?
Schweizer's solutions are straightforward:
Ban birth tourism -- Congress must prohibit the industry facilitating foreign nationals traveling here solely to birth American citizens.
Reform birthright citizenship -- The Supreme Court should clarify that the 14th Amendment was about freed slaves under U.S. jurisdiction, not birth tourists who immediately return to foreign countries.
Change the Census -- Count citizens, not people. Stop incentivizing states to harbor illegal immigrants for political power.
Secure the border -- Continue deportations despite resistance from states benefiting politically from illegal immigration.
Awareness -- Schweizer briefed President Donald Trump, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and key members of Congress. They were surprised by much of what he revealed. "Until we deal with weaponized immigration," he said, "we can't have a good conversation about the level of legal immigration we want."
"I'm optimistic," Schweizer said. "I feel like people are finally getting what's really going on."
Let's hope he's right. And let's hope we're not already too late.

body:
Trump and his allies are worried that Americans will vote them out.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260304-269&t=1&akid=269%2E12592%2EqMSRPJ)
It's Elizabeth Warren.
Look: Trump and his allies are worried that Americans will vote them out.
But instead of offering up better, more popular ideas, they’ve decided to redraw Congressional maps in their favor instead.

First things first, friends, I hope this note finds you well.

I recently connected with you and shared I am on a mission to earn your vote as I run for Lieutenant Governor of Rhode Island. It’s so important to me that I run a people-centered campaign that does more listening than talking. _That’s why I asked you to submit your questions. I’ll be digging into those soon!_

Today, I’m pushing past my personal comfort zone to make a request that will feel a bit unusual from my typical newsletter updates...

Running a statewide campaign means doing a few things differently — **[including asking you for financial support, if that’s something you’re able to do at this time.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv4_gAZ_PeyVWOO5HP-pHiWu2wfav_zDUWpFqNcezVI_5UFbXLzt157r5CJU7QoUN_P4KToTqgh4wzV4Bwe_LwYLGGjTdbqukrHeYBwVngiMnqX-VNmM9KYSN-Xh2RXxBGQiFcKeUCFZcxe7OSbhyQ-mujtotyD1LUfs7skFE40nfz6ITMFwzyv5FGNVCV0yBN84GUB-TP9xmGDd0gcmBewu4UpE1XWEKZyTNbh1AtYceMqGCbaxJyDJO2M-hDJJjRPtk5JaDEk2RD7gJDHj2NFK16k6DiZFq2WR5SILlpcgmQNwAHM69gbrmK8KgfLDatJkhFiGL3jzIHendF_iYTu/4on/m4R4wVuRT9OsBMD7x4zsqQ/h0/h001.o1wd62jQsEooiPhgiUU3WdovZuC1b2vyvqTtdwVpFPk)**

This campaign is about **relationships**. It’s about neighbors stepping up together to make Rhode Island more affordable, more resilient, and more equitable. It’s about showing what government can do when it actually works for regular people.

It’s about being out there, listening, and earning votes.

I want to take the needed time with Rhode Islanders to hear your thoughts, concerns, and questions. I also want to take time to actively engage and provide clear answers about tangible things I would do in office to address the things you care about.

These connections will be formed through community events, phone calls, emails, door-to-door interactions, mailers, campaign ads, and equipping a team of staff and volunteers to organize on my behalf and being my voice when I can’t be in the room.

And, honestly, all of this costs money, especially to do it right.

If you **can’t** donate right now (or choose not to!), that doesn't change how much I value having you alongside this effort. Your time, your attention, your ideas, your willingness to talk with neighbors: all of that matters just as much as any check.

Thank you for being part of this community. For listening, for engaging, for pushing to make things better. I’m grateful for you.

With gratitude,

Sue

name: David Hogg
subject: The future of the Democratic Party is here
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Julio Salinas and Christian Menefee advanced to runoff elections last night, proving that we have what it takes to challenge power.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260304-1&t=1&akid=3213%2E587540%2EpxcW91)
Peter,
Last night proved something huge: **We have what it takes to challenge power and truly reshape the future of the Democratic Party.**
We’re absolutely fired up that **Christian Menefee** and **Julio Salinas** have both come in first in their primaries in Texas and advanced to runoff elections. They didn’t just run strong campaigns, they forced the establishment to put up a fight, and showed exactly what people-powered organizing can do.
Tuesday’s primaries were one of the first real tests of what we can accomplish. Voters showed up in record breaking numbers, driven by the audacious young leaders of our movement who refuse to sit on the sidelines and settle for politics as usual.
In Texas’ House District 41, Julio ran on fighting for working families in the Valley — a livable wage, stronger public schools, and affordable health care. His advancement last night shows the hunger voters have for someone who truly represents their values, and will answer to them, not corporate PACs or special interests.
And in Christian’s race in Texas’ 18th congressional district, he challenged a two decade incumbent and proved that his commitment to taking on corporate greed and fighting to make life better for working people is resonating in a huge way with a new generation of voters. He’s showing us what it looks like to lead with integrity, and be accountable to the people he serves.
**This is exactly the future Leaders We Deserve is fighting for: A Democratic Party that doesn’t compromise its values, and knows how to win.**
But our work isn’t done — winning this will come down to turnout. May 26 will be our next battle, and thanks to the thousands of voters who made their voices heard last night, we have a real shot at victory. We need all hands on deck to keep our momentum going and win.
**[Will you chip in $5 right now to help Leaders We Deserve power Julio and Christian to victory on May 26? Every act of mobilization right now is critical, and your support will help us tip the scales.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260304_1_runoff.9T4_f9&refcode=em20260304-3213&amount=5&t=2&akid=3213%2E587540%2EpxcW91)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

clean_body: We can’t wait until October | = Hi Peter, Donald Trump can’t run for reelection. That’s a constitutional fact. But that hasn’t stopped him from raising more than $1.5 BILLION for his personal Super PAC. Corporate tycoons, tobacco companies, and Republican megadonors have all made generous donations to Trump’s Super PAC, earning themselves presidential pardons and impunity from government regulation. = | = Here’s why this matters: a cash advantage of that size gives Republicans the power to keep candidates and elected officials beholden to Trump — and to use that flood of outside spending to protect the razor-thin GOP House majority, regardless of the will of American voters. We cannot let Republicans buy their way into a congressional majority at the expense of our families. That’s why our endorsed candidates are doing the hard work that Trump’s allies think they can spend their way out of: showing up, organizing, and building real grassroots momentum in their communities. EMILYs List women have a message for their GOP opponents: seats in Congress aren’t for sale. But the fundraising gap is real. # US sub sinks Iranian warship for the first torpedo kill since WW2
A U.S. Navy submarine sank an Iranian frigate with a torpedo in the Indian Ocean off Sri Lanka overnight, marking the first enemy ship **[sunk by an American submarine torpedo since World War II,](https://substack.com/redirect/c36e2b05-6cd1-406d-9378-8bfc4f58b104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced Wednesday, as part of escalating strikes that have crippled Iran's navy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c36e2b05-6cd1-406d-9378-8bfc4f58b104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Over Twenty Vessels Destroyed:** U.S. forces have sunk or struck more than 20 Iranian warships including a submarine rendering Tehran's naval fleet largely inoperable globally not just regionally.
* **Prize Ship Targeted:** Iran's Shahid Soleimani a modern catamaran corvette armed with anti-ship missiles was sunk emphasizing total degradation of regime naval assets.
* **Global Power Projection:** The strike demonstrates unmatched U.S. capability to hunt and eliminate Iranian vessels far from the Persian Gulf in international waters.
* **High Casualties Reported:** Sri Lankan rescue operations recovered dozens of survivors but over 80 crew members from the frigate perished amid contested death tolls.

# UFO-linked General vanishes mysteriously in Albuquerque
Retired Air Force Maj. Gen. William Neil McCasland, 68, who once commanded labs tied to UFO lore and advanced aerospace research, **[vanished Friday in Albuquerque, New Mexico,](https://substack.com/redirect/8673d331-5668-42d6-9824-55358a675ddc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** leaving home without his phone or watch. Authorities issued a Silver Alert amid medical concerns, with the FBI now aiding the search and a possible sighting reported near a local trail.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8673d331-5668-42d6-9824-55358a675ddc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Possible Trail Sighting:** A woman reported seeing a man matching McCasland's description near the Whitewash trailhead in Piedra Lisa Canyon on Friday, standing by a bridge; officials urge direct tips to BCSO.
* **Unusual Departure Habits:** The general left without his usual watch or phone, which friends called highly out of character for the avid hiker and recent 60-mile bike rider.
* **Career UFO Speculation:** His name appeared in WikiLeaks emails where musician Tom DeLonge claimed McCasland advised on UFO disclosure and UAP information release, though unconfirmed officially.
* **Massive Search Operation:** New Mexico Search and Rescue, drones, K9 teams, and helicopters scoured Albuquerque Open Space areas over the weekend, with no foul play suspected per his wife.

# Trump drops bombshell ultimatum on Texas primary run off
President Donald Trump declared on Truth Social Wednesday that he will[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/5f768e0e-b3e0-4da8-9d7f-5571995aea5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[soon endorse one candidate](https://substack.com/redirect/5f768e0e-b3e0-4da8-9d7f-5571995aea5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in Texas' Republican Senate primary runoff between Sen. John Cornyn and Attorney General Ken Paxton, demanding the other immediately drop out to unify the party against the Democratic nominee and avoid a prolonged, divisive battle ahead of November's general election.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b337ae07-fe43-49b3-b9ac-da5e88a7b926?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump 's Dramatic Demand**: Trump insisted the primary "MUST STOP NOW" for party and country unity, emphasizing focus on defeating the "easy to beat" Radical Left opponent in November.
* **Praise For Both Rivals** : He acknowledged both Cornyn and Paxton "ran great races, but not good enough," stressing the need for a "PERFECT" nominee to secure victory.
* **Boast Of Endorsement Power** : Trump highlighted his near-unbeatable endorsement record, noting endorsed Republicans win big "especially in Texas," framing his upcoming choice as decisive.
* **Runoff Context Revealed** : The May runoff follows the March 3 primary where neither secured a majority, advancing Cornyn and Paxton after Trump stayed neutral during the initial contest.

name: Hong for Wisconsin
subject: Tax the ultrarich
disclaimer_text: paid for by gutting Medicaid and food assistance, and Wisconsin taxpayers are now subsidizing $284 million of that bill
body:
Lower taxes for the rest of us
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260304-2576)
Peter,
Tom Tiffany voted for Trump's “One Big Beautiful Bill” and called it a major win for the American people. But the only winners are the richest 1% of Americans, who are getting an average tax cut of $68,000. Even worse: This is paid for by gutting Medicaid and food assistance, and Wisconsin taxpayers are now subsidizing $284 million of that bill.
Let’s be clear: Tiffany voted to make rich people richer (at our expense!). Now he's running for governor and pretending to care about your tax bill.
Earlier this year, he rolled out his plan for Wisconsin: freeze property taxes and slash spending. Except he’s not telling us what gets cut — because he knows we won’t like the answer.
What’s the saying about squeezing blood from a stone? Our public schools have already been gutted. Special education reimbursement is at 35% when it should be 90%. Teachers are leaving the profession in droves. And Tiffany's solution is to squeeze working people even harder while protecting every cent of the tax breaks he handed to the mega rich and corporations in Congress.
One of the reasons property taxes are so high is that Wisconsin homeowners are being asked to pick up the shortfall in state funding. That’s why 241 municipalities put referenda to increase property taxes on the ballot in 2024.
I have a different option: tax the rich to fund schools.
[My bill](https://act.francescahong.com/go/3578?t=1&akid=2576%2E105371%2El6y2hR) creates a new 10% tax bracket on the millionth dollar of income and above, which will fully fund public schools and raise special education reimbursement to 90% while also taking the burden of school funding off of property taxes — estimated by the Wisconsin Legislative Reference Bureau to cut the average property tax bill by 44%.
Our government is committed to giving the super-rich a free ride and asking regular Wisconsinites to bail them out. We can’t fix this unless we tackle it at the source: We need the wealthiest Wisconsinites to pay their fair share.
Tiffany wants to protect tax breaks for the ultra wealthy and pretend it’s relief for everyday people.
I want to actually fix the system that's squeezing us to death and make life more affordable.
**[But I can't do it without you. Can you chip in $10 to help us build a campaign that fights for working families instead of bowing to billionaires?](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260304.sTsaNO&refcode=em20260304-2576&t=2&akid=2576%2E105371%2El6y2hR)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260304.sTsaNO&amount=5&refcode=em20260304-2576&t=21&akid=2576%2E105371%2El6y2hR)**
With gratitude,
— Fran

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: We won, Peter!
body:
Last night’s win couldn’t have been possible without you, Peter.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**It’s official, Peter! I am the Democratic nominee for Governor of Texas, and I’ll be facing Greg Abbott this November.**
And now, we move into the next phase of this race with one mission in mind — defeating Greg Abbott and ending the era of corruption and negligence he has inflicted on Texas.
Thank you, Peter. This wouldn’t have been possible without your support.
To every volunteer who knocked doors, every organizer who made the calls, every supporter who chipped in what they could, and every Texan who believed in this campaign early, _**thank you**_. You carried us over the first big hurdle and made it clear that Texans are ready to turn the page.
Now the general election is underway, and our mission is clear. We are going to defeat Greg Abbott and end the era of corruption and negligence he has inflicted on Texas.
[**If you’re ready to keep the pressure on and keep building momentum, will you pitch in $5 right now to help us start strong?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260304_3_results.4zBjiW&refcode=em20260304-704&amount=5&t=1&akid=704%2E299639%2En9npiS)
Politics was never the plan for me. But when they tried to close my son’s neighborhood school, I couldn’t just stand on the sidelines and do nothing about it — so I turned my anger into action and ran for the school board to change things. _And I won_. Since then, I’ve fought for Texas families alongside union teachers and parents of every political background because this is not about party. It is about putting our kids first.
**As the Democratic nominee for Governor, I will fight for Texans the same way I fight for my own kids,_with everything I’ve got_.**
As Governor of Texas, I will work to build a state where:
* You can see a doctor without worrying that it will bankrupt your family.
* Your paycheck goes further at the grocery store and at the pharmacy
* And make sure every child has a strong neighborhood public school, with supported teachers and safe classrooms.

After over a decade of Greg Abbott, Texans have watched the cost of living explode, public schools gutted and politicized, corruption run rampant, and millions denied health care. Texans are ready for something better.
But Abbott has a massive $106 million war chest, and starting today, his billionaire donors are ready to write a blank check just to keep him in power.
**[That is why I’m asking. Will you help power my campaign with a contribution of $5 today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260304_3_results.4zBjiW&refcode=em20260304-704&amount=5&t=2&akid=704%2E299639%2En9npiS)**

Let’s win this together.
With gratitude,
Gina Hinojosa

name: Deb Haaland
subject: I’m not like most people running for office, friend
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Can I share my story with you?

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7930%2E400544%2E87YZXq)
---
Friend, I want to tell you about a milestone I’m proud of: **I have reached 36 years of sobriety.**
Most people running for office wouldn’t choose to speak candidly about alcohol addiction. **But I’m not like most people running for office. My story is different.**
I was about 23 years old when I made the brave decision to get sober. It was a struggle at first, but I persevered because I was committed to doing all I could. I went to AA meetings and probably read 20 books on addiction.
My struggles made me fierce, which is why I chose to speak openly about my sobriety in my very first campaign ad when I ran for Congress. And I’m so glad I did. I'll never forget the day we went to the Marigold Parade in the South Valley, and people came up to me right and left and thanked me for saying that in my ad. They shared stories about themselves, their parents, and their loved ones struggling with addiction, and it brought tears to my eyes that people felt that someone like me represented them.
**My journey to sobriety taught me that you must face hard truths if you want to make change, which is why I’ll never shy away from the tough fights that lie ahead for New Mexico.**
Affordability, crime, poverty, homelessness, and addiction are weighing heavy on our state, and I intend to tackle those challenges head-on as governor. I promise to be honest about topics other politicians might try to sweep under the rug, because I believe if we’re brave, we can heal.
Thank you for hearing my story, friend. That’s how we’ll win this race — by sharing our stories, lifting each other up, and being fierce enough to fight for the bright future New Mexicans deserve. If you can, **[I’d be grateful if you’d pitch in $5 so we can keep traveling New Mexico to hear from voters and win this race.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk292-fr-nd&amount=5&t=2&akid=7930%2E400544%2E87YZXq)**
| | [Donate >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk292-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7930%2E400544%2E87YZXq)
---
Thank you for everything.

Deb

name: Tobias Read
subject: We can’t let President Trump get away with this
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em]
We’re now hearing reports that President Donald Trump is considering an executive order declaring a so-called “emergency” to seize greater federal authority over elections.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em]
This is deeply alarming to say the least.
But you don’t have to take my word for it: Our founders were explicit about this. They had just fought a king. They understood that concentrating too much power in one person was dangerous. That’s why the Constitution divides authority and states administer elections.
That’s why no president — no matter how loud or how desperate — gets to override the system because he’s afraid of losing.
As Oregon’s Secretary of State, I oversee our elections. I take an oath to the Constitution — not to any president. And I will stand up to any administration that tries to abuse emergency powers to interfere with Oregon’s voting systems or intimidate our election workers.
But I need your help to keep up the fight in light of Trump’s illegal actions, which is why I’m reaching out today. Can I count on you to join me in this fight against President Trump’s lawlessness by chipping in $5, $10, or more right away? Communicating this threat to Oregonians across the state takes resources. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em]
We’ve already beaten back federal overreach in court before. When attempts were made to stretch authority beyond its limits, Oregon pushed back — and won.
If we have to do it again, we will.
But defending democracy requires a strong grassroots team prepared to meet the fight head-on — and that’s where you come in.
If you believe, as I do, that no president should be able to manufacture an emergency to grab control over elections, I’m asking you to stand with me. Please contribute today to help us protect Oregon’s elections and hold President Trump accountable before it’s too late. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260304em]
Thank you,
Tobias Read

I came to Colorado for a job interview over three decades ago, and right away I was hooked. I love how innovative and independent Coloradans are. I love how we care about one another. And I love how we cherish our natural resources, are proud of our beautiful state, and protect our land, air, and water. I am honored by the opportunity to fight for you, serving as your attorney general for the past several years.
My wife and I have called Colorado home for many years, and we plan to live here for many more. **But, I worry about whether our two kids — both of whom grew up here — will be able to do the same.**
After touring our state more than once to have conversations with you, one of the top concerns I’ve heard is whether people can afford to live in Colorado. From health care to housing to child care and beyond, Coloradans everywhere are getting squeezed. They want their next governor to fight for them and forge solutions that can help more of us stay in the state we love. **I decided to run for governor because _I am ready to meet these challenges head-on and lead our state on day one._**
You’ve also told me about how much you want your next governor to fight back against the Trump administration’s disrespect for our rights and the rule of law. I’m proud to have been in this fight ever since the inauguration — as AG, I have filed over 50 lawsuits against this administration, and we’re winning again and again because the law is on our side. **No other candidate for Colorado governor can say this:_I’ve taken every single opportunity to stand up to Trump’s federal government — and I’m not stopping now._**
As a first-generation American, the fight to protect our democratic republic is deeply personal. My mother and grandmother both came to this country after surviving a Nazi concentration camp. Their story of resilience inspired me to pursue public service, including working for Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg at the U.S. Supreme Court and President Barack Obama in the White House.
**[Folks, I made the decision to run for governor because I love our state. I’m ready to protect Coloradans from lawless bullies, fight for an affordable Colorado, and ensure that our kids have the opportunities to thrive that they deserve. Winning this race isn’t guaranteed — it will take every single one of us caucusing, organizing, and pitching in to make it happen.
